In the medial compartment, the meniscus is not torn and there is no focal chondrosis or chondral injury. 
 The lateral compartment, there is suspicious incomplete discoid lateral meniscus without tear. There is no focal chondrosis or chondral injury. 
 The patellofemoral joint, the patellar and trochlear cartilage appears congruent without chondral lesion. The medial patellofemoral ligament is intact.  
 In the intercondylar notch, the anterior and posterior cruciate ligaments are intact. There is no tibial translation. 
 The medial collateral ligament complexes are intact. The posteromedial oblique ligament is intact.  
 The lateral collateral ligament complexes are intact. The popliteofibular ligament is intact. The meniscopopliteal fascicles are intact.  
 The extensor mechanism is normal.  
 No knee effusion is present. The surrounding musculature is normal. There is no fracture or bone contusion.  Suspicious incomplete discoid lateral meniscus without tear. 
  Intact cartilage and ligaments of left knee.

medial. También hay discreto edema del tejido adiposo entre el cóndilo femoral lateral y la banda
iliotibial.

fenómenos de mal alineamiento patelar.
Leve tendinosis patelar proximal.
Signos que sugieren fenómenos de fricción posteromedial y de la banda iliotibial, correlacionar con
clínica

MRI of left knee with -Locator, SG PD FatSat, SG T2W FS, SG T1W, CO T2W FS, AX T2W FS

Findings:
> The contour of anterior cruciate ligament is in a straight line but increase signal intensity inside, likely due to sprain
> One cystic lesion posterior to ACL, maybe due to ganglion cyst
> The contour of posterior cruciate ligaments appearing within normal limit
> No definite tear of medial or lateral meniscus in this study
> Normal appearance of medial and lateral collateral ligaments
> No significant bone marrow edema or active cortical destruction in distal femur, proximal tibia and fibula in this study.
> Minimal joint effusion

Impression:
1. ACL sprain
2. Suspect ACL ganglion cyst

Suggest correlation with clinical manifestation.

-Locator, SG PD FatSat, SG T1W, SG T2W FS, CO T2W FS, AX T2W FS


> Fracture of posterior tibial intercondylar eminence with avulsion fracture of PCL.
    Bone marrow edema in proximal tibia.
> The contour of PCL is not all in a straight line and increase signal intensity inside, in favor of partial tear.
> The contour of ACL appears to be within normal, no abnormal signal intensity is noted.
> Linear signal intensity in posterior horn of medial meniscus and anterior horn of lateral meniscus with extending into the surface, R/O tear.
> Both medial & lateral collateral ligaments appear to be within normal.
> Joint effusion and suprapatellar bursitis with suprapatellar and medial plicae; hypertrophy of the synovium, indicative of synovitis. Deep infrapatellar bursitis.
> Joint effusion and suprapatellar bursitis with suprapatellar and medial plicae; hypertrophy of the synovium with some fatty frondlike  excrescences ectending from the synovial surface over lateral suprapatellar region, in favor of  synovitis and R/O lipoma arborescens (diffuse synovial lipoma)
> Bone marrow edema over mdeial aspect of medial femoral condyle.
> Subcutaneous and muscle edema over left knee
> Wearing of articular cartilage and spur formation with subchondral edema

Impression: 
1. Posterior tibial intercondylar eminence fracture with avulsion fracture of PCL and partial tear of PCL.
2. Bone contusion in medial femoral condyle and tibial plateau.
3. Osteoarthritis of left knee.
4. Degeneration of medial and lateral meniscus and R/O tear of anterior horn of lateral meniscus and posterior horn of medial meniscus.
5. Synovitis of left knee with suprapatellar and deep infrapatellar bursitis; R/O  lipoma arborescens over lateral aspect of  left knee.
6. Subcutaneous and muscle edema over left knee.
Suggest correlation with clinical manifestation

The study reveals anterior tibial translation.  Mild bone contusion at posterior lateral proximal tibia is observed.  
  -  Hyperintense disrupted proximal MCL with focal fluid is noted.  
    Medial bulging medial meniscus with myxoid change in entire of the anterior to posterior horn is observed.  Massive radial tear at posterior root is detected.    
 -  Mild hyperintense proximal FCL and proximal popliteus tendon are observed.  Hyperintense distal biceps femoris tendon is noted.     
   Horizontal tear at anterior horn lateral meniscus, with complex tear at meniscal body  
 and radial tear at posterior root of the lateral meniscus are detected.  
 -   Loss of signal of entire of the ACL.  Hyperintense proximal PCL with Loss of distal part PCL is noted.     
 -  Diffuse thinning articular cartilage along the medial and lateral tibiofemoral and PF joint is observed.  
    Small full-thickness cartilaginous defect, about 3mm., at posterior lateral tibial plateau with subchondral bone edema is noted.   
   Fissuring cartilage at patellar apex without subchondral bone lesion is noted.  
  
 - Moderate joint effusion with fluid distended suprapatellar bursa with thickened synovial tissue are observed.  
 - Quadriceps and patellar tendons are intact.  
 - Fat atrophic change of the muscles, less than 50% muscle volume loss;  predominantly involved vastus  muscles is observed.      - Complete tear of ACL and PCL 
    - High grade partial tear at proximal MCL  
    - Proximal FCL sprain, proximal popliteus tendon strain, distal biceps femoris tendon strain 
    -  Myxoid change of the medial meniscus with radial tear at posterior horn 
    -  Horizontal tear at anterior horn lateral meniscus, with complex tear at meniscal body  
 and radial tear at posterior root of the lateral meniscus 
   -  Chondrosis of the medial and lateral tibiofemoral and PF joint 
   -  Fissuring cartilage at patellar apex without subchondral bone lesion, Chondropathy grade2

       subchondral bone edema, chondropathy grade4. 
    - Mild synovitis of the knee and PF joint.

> Increased fat stranding at popliteal region, most due to trauma.

1. Tibial plateau fracture and fubilar head fracture with bone contusion at lateral femoral condyle, proximal tibia and fibula.
2. Avulsion fracture of ACL insertion site with associated Grade 2 ACL injury.
3. Traumatic lipohemarthrosis of knee joint.
Suggest correlation with clinical manifestation

Na učinjenim sekvencima prati se teška gonartroza, izraženija u medijalnom kompartmentu
femorotibijalnog zgloba gdje je vidljiva denudacija tibijalne i kondilarne hrskavice uz koštani
edem zglobnih tijela. Degenerativno stanjene ostale zglobne hrskavice uz mjestimične fisure.
Vidi se izrazito degenerativno promijenjen i deformiran medijalni menisk uz kompleksnu rupturu
tijela i dijela stražnjeg roga medijalnog meniska. Bez progresije u ekstruziji.
Lateralni menisk je degenerativno promijenjen uz suspektnu horizontalnu rupturu stražnjeg roga
i disrupciju posteroinferiornog popliteomeniscealnog fascikla. Posljedično izljev u poplitealnom
hijatusu koji je proširen.
Uznapredovala mukoidna degeneracija prednjeg križnog ligamena bez znakova rupture.
Sitna Baker cista. Manji izljev u zglobnom prostoru, predominantno u suprapatelarnoj burzi i
infrapatelarno.

MRI of right knee in sagittal section (Proton density with fat saturation, T1WI, T2WI with fat saturation), axial section (T2WI with fat saturation) and coronal section (T2WI with fat saturation):

* Blurred contour of posterior cruciate ligament (PCL) with increased signal intensity is noticed, in favor of PCL tear.

* Small osteochondral lesion at posterior portion of medial femoral condyle is suspected.

* There are two fusiform lesions in the subcutaneous region of prepatellar region and medial aspect of knee, showing heterogeneous hyperintensity on T1WI and T2WI, in favor of hematomas.

* Subcutaneous soft tissue edema around right knee is noticed.

* Exostosis at medial portion of proximal tibia is noticed, osteochondroma is considered.

> The contour of anterior cruciate ligament (ACL) appears to be within normal, no abnormal signal intensity is noted.
> No evidence of tear is noted in either medial or lateral meniscus.
> Both medial & lateral collateral ligaments appear to be within normal.
> No evidence of bone contusion is noted.

Impressions: 
1. In favor of PCL tear
2. R/O small osteochondral lesion at posterior portion of medial femoral condyle
3. In favor of subcutaneous hematomas at prepatellar region and medial aspect of right knee
4. Osteochondroma at medial portion of proximal tibia

Suggest clinical correlation

MRI of left Knee with 
-Locator, SG PD FatSat, SG T2W FS, AX T2W FS, CO T2W FS, SG T1W



> Fracture of posterior aspect of tibial intercondylar eminence of left proximal tibia with displaced bony fragment, just at PCL attchment, C/W avulsion fracture of PCL. 
> Bone marrow edema over left proximal tibia and lower pole of patella.
> The contour of PCL not all in a straight line and increase signal intensity inside on F/S T2WI, in favor of partial tear.
  Interstitial increase signal intensity of ACL on F/S T2WI, infavor of grade 1 injury.
> Lipohemarthrosis of left knee and suprapatellar bursitis; mild deep infrapatellar bursitis.
> Generalized soft tissue swelling over left knee, including subcutaneous and muscular layer and increased fat stranding over intermuscular region.
> Linear signal intensity in posterior horn of medial meniscus, without significant extending into the surface, in favor of grade 2 intrasubstance signal of posterior horn of medial meniscus, maybe due to degeneration or contusion.
> Both medial & lateral collateral ligaments appear to be within normal.
> Mild interstitial increased signal intensity of quadriceps tendon and distal patellar tendon on F/S T2WI, in favor of tendinosis or grade 1 injury.
> Increased fat stranding and minimal fluid accumulation located along the pes anserinus, reflecting Anserine bursitis

Impression: 
1. C/W PCL avulsion fracture and partial tear of PCL.
2. Grade 1 injury of ACL.
3. Left tibial intercondylar eminence fracture with bone marrow edema over left proximal tibia; bone contusion of left lower patella.
4. Lipohemarthrosis of left knee.
5. Subcutaneous and muscle edema around left knee and intermuscular edema.
6. Anserine bursitis.
7. Grade 2 intrasubstance signal of posterior horn of medial meniscus, maybe due to degeneration or contusion.
8. Tendinosis or grade 1 injury of patellar tendon and quadriceps tendon.
Suggest correlation with clinical manifestation and further management

In the medial compartment, there are radial tears at the anterior horn, body and posterior horn of the medial meniscus. There is diffuse low grade chondrosis (less thab 50% thickness cartilage loss) at posterior weightbaring medial femoral condyle and medial tibial plateau. A intact3 cm subchondral bone cyst is present. Osteophytes are identified. 
   
 The lateral compartment, there is large radial tear at the posterior horn of the lateral meniscus. There is chronic osteochondral injury at the posterolateral tibial plateau (about 2.3* 1.3 cm). There is subchondral edema.  
  
 The patellofemoral joint, the patellar and trochlear cartilage appears congruent without chondral lesion. The medial patellofemoral ligament is intact.  
  
 In the intercondylar notch, there is chronic complete tear of the anterior cruciate ligament, at mid substance. The posterior cruciate ligament is intact. There is anterior anterior tibial translation. 
  
 The medial collateral ligamentous complexes are intact. The posteromedial oblique ligament is intact.  
 The lateral collateral ligament complexes are intact. The popliteofibular ligament is intact. The meniscopopliteal fascicles are intact.  
 The extensor mechanism is normal.  
 Some amount of right knee effusion is present. A intact6 cm loose body in the posteromedial recess.The surrounding musculature is normal.  Mild medial tibiofemoral compartmental osteoarthritis of the right knee by evidence of chondrosis, subchondral bone cyst and osteophytes. 
  Chronic osteochondral injury at the posterolateral tibial plateau (about 2.3* 1.3 cm).

original_report:
COMPARISON:None.

CLINICAL HISTORY:Assess proximal patellar tendon tear left knee.

PROCEDURE:Multisequence, multiplanar unenhanced MRI of the left knee according to routine protocol.

IMAGING FINDINGS:

Nondiagnostic scout localizing images reviewed..

The lateral meniscus is intact. Inferiorly surfacing oblique tear posterior horn medial meniscus extending into the body, which is peripherally extruded. Multilobulated para meniscal cyst measuring 6 x 2 x 2 mm noted adjacent to the posterior horn of the medial meniscus at the tear site.

Intact anterior cruciate ligament and posterior cruciate ligament.

The medial collateral ligament, posterior oblique ligament, fibular collateral ligament, popliteus and biceps femoris tendon attachments, as well as iliotibial band are intact.

Mild quadriceps and patellar tendinosis without tears. The patellar retinacula are intact. No femoral trochlear dysplasia. The TT-TG distance measures 6 mm, within normal limits.

Preserved patellofemoral articular cartilage. Preserved medial and lateral femorotibial articular cartilage.

Trace knee joint fluid. Regional musculature is within normal limits. No suspicious focal marrow signal alteration. Bone islands in the distal femur and proximal tibia. 

IMPRESSION:
1. Inferiorly surfacing incomplete tear or of the medial meniscus extending into the body, with medial meniscal extrusion and adjacent parameniscal cyst formation.
2. Quadriceps and patellar tendinosis without tears.

original_report: МР находка: МР данни за скъсване на задния рог на медиалния менискус. Задният рог на медиалния менискус е дегенеративно променен.  Той е с повишен интензитет на сигнала като в него се вижда хиперинтенсна линия с радиерен ход, съответстваща на скъсване. Скъсването достига до края на менискуса и ставния хрущял на тибията. МР данни за начална медиална гонартроза. Ставният хрущял от медиалната страна е изтънен и е с неравни контурни очертания. Наличие на течност в медиалното ставно пространство. Няма данни за ставен излив. Нормално изобразяване на латералния менискус. Предна и задна кръстна връзка – б.о. Колатерални лигаменти – б.о. Ретинакулуми – б.о. Патела, хрущял на пателата – б.о. Дорзално между задната кръстна връзка и ставната капсула се вижда овално, добре отграничено хипоинтенсно тяло с големина 4,6/2,5мм. Най-вероятно се касае за вътреставна мишка. Костите, формиращи дясната колянна става, са с нормална форма. Наличие на слабо изразен костномозъчен едем в епифизата на тибията. Заключение: МР данни за начална медиална гонартроза на дясната колянна става със скъсване на задния рог на медиалния менискус. Нискосигнална овална лезия дорзално вътреставно с вид на ставна мишка. Слабо изразен костномозъчен едем епифизарно в тибията.

issues.reason: The report explicitly describes an oval, well-defined hypointense body dorsally between the posterior cruciate ligament and joint capsule measuring 4.6/2.5 mm, stating 'Най-вероятно се касае за вътреставна мишка' (most likely an intra-articular mouse/loose body). In the context of knee MRI reporting, this description and location are characteristic of a Baker's cyst/popliteal cyst. The statement 'Няма данни за ставен излив' (no data for joint effusion/extravasation) refers to absence of fluid outside the joint capsule, not absence of a popliteal cyst. GOLD_ANALYSIS shows Baker's cysts are labeled independently from effusion.

issues.label: Contusion
issues.reason: The report describes 'слабо изразен костномозъчен едем в епифизата на тибията' (mild bone marrow edema in the tibial epiphysis). According to RAGSET rules, bone marrow edema alone is not universally equivalent to contusion. The report does not use explicit contusion/bone bruise terminology ('костна контузия' or 'костна синьоза'). In the context of medial meniscus tear and early medial gonarthrosis, this edema likely represents chronic/subchondral reactive changes rather than acute bone contusion. GOLD_ANALYSIS indicates Contusion requires explicit bone contusion/bone bruise language supported by report context.

issues.label: Effusion
issues.reason: The report explicitly states 'Minimalno tekućine u Bakerovoj burzi' (minimal fluid in Baker's bursa). In the knee, a Baker's cyst/bursa communicates with the joint; minimal fluid in the Baker's bursa represents minimal joint effusion. The observed RagSet convention (Effusion: 35 positive / 23 negative) supports labeling explicit minimal fluid as Effusion=1.

TECHNIQUE:
MRI of the left knee was performed on a 1.5 Tesla. system with a dedicated knee coil in three planes (axial, sagittal, and coronal), using a standard non-contrast protocol.

FINDINGS:
OSSEOUS STRUCTURES:
There is moderate subcortical cystic change in the patella likely related to overlying chondromalacia. The Alignment is anatomic. No acute fracture or bone bruise. Background marrow signal is normal without infiltrative marrow process. No aggressive osseous lesions.

JOINT SPACE:
No joint effusion. No intra-articular bodies. No Baker's cyst.

MEDIAL COMPARTMENT:
Medial meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.
Medial compartment cartilage: No focal cartilage defects.

LATERAL COMPARTMENT:
Lateral meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal. Previously identified linear hyperintense focus is no longer seen.
Lateral compartment cartilage: No focal cartilage defects.

PATELLOFEMORAL COMPARTMENT:
Patellofemoral compartment cartilage: There is severe chondromalacia patella most pronounced at the apex and inferior aspect of the lateral facet..

CRUCIATE LIGAMENTS:
Anterior cruciate ligament (ACL): Normal with both bundles intact.
Posterior cruciate ligament (PCL): Normal.

COLLATERAL LIGAMENTS & POSTEROLATERAL CORNER:
Medial collateral ligament (MCL): Normal.
Lateral collateral ligament (LCL) complex: Normal.
Posterolateral corner structures: Normal.

EXTENSOR MECHANISM:
Distal quadriceps tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Patella tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Medial patellofemoral ligament (MPFL) and patellar retinacula: Normal.
Patellofemoral tracking: No edema in superolateral Hoffa's fat pad. No lateral patellar tilt or translation. No patella alta. Normal patellar and trochlear morphology. 

MUSCLES/TENDONS:
Again noted is tendinosis at the origin of the medial head of the gastrocnemius. Visualized tendons not previously discussed are intact without tendinosis or tear.

SOFT TISSUES:
No soft tissue mass. Normal popliteal neurovascular bundle.


IMPRESSION:
1. Severe chondromalacia patella.
2. No meniscal tear identified. 
3. Tendinosis at the origin of the medial head of the gastrocnemius, left pronounced than on the prior study.

Antecedentes Clínicos:
Lesiones degenerativas mediales.
Hallazgos:
No hay alteraciones difusas de señal de la médula ósea.
Adelgazamiento condral difuso de espesor total de la región anterior y central de carga del
compartimento femorotibial medial. Esto se asocia a moderado edema óseo regional de ambas
superficies, con esclerosis subcondral y osteofitos marginales.
Ligamentos conservados y colaterales de grosor y señal conservados.
El menisco lateral presenta fibrilación difusa de su borde libre, con alteración de señal
intrasustancia del cuerno anterior de carácter degenerativo.
Moderada extrusión del menisco medial, con rotura radial de los dos tercios internos del cuerno
posterior. Rotura compleja de la región corporal, con fibrilación del borde libre, un componente
vertical oblicuo y otro horizontal, que determina desplazamiento de tejido meniscal al receso
menisco tibial. Moderado edema parameniscal.
Irregularidad superficial difusa del cartílago del compartimento femorotibial lateral.
Moderado adelgazamiento condral con úlceras de espesor total en la región central y faceta
medial de la patela. Irregularidad superficial difusa del cartílago troclear, con adelgazamiento de
espesor moderado en la vertiente medial.
Leve a moderado derrame articular, con leve engrosamiento sinovial difuso. No hay quistes
poplíteos.
Engrosamiento y aumento de señal de la plica patelar medial, que se extiende sobre la vertiente
medial de la tróclea.
Leve engrosamiento y aumento de señal del tendón proximal del gastrocnemio medial, con
imagen sugerente de fina rotura parcial intrasustancia.
Tendones del cuádriceps, patelar, poplíteo, semimembranoso, bíceps femoral, banda iliotibial y
tendones de la pata de ganso de grosor y señal conservado.
Grupos musculares de trofismo y señal conservado.
Impresión:
Rotura radial prácticamente completa del cuerno posterior del menisco medial, con moderada
extrusión meniscal, asociado a una rotura compleja de la región corporal y desplazamiento de
tejido meniscal al receso menisco tibial.
Cambios degenerativos del menisco lateral, con fibrilación difusa del borde libre.
Condropatía femorotibial medial difusa grado 4, con edema óseo regional sugerente de
fenómenos de sobrecarga.
Condropatía femorotibial lateral grado 2. Condropatía patelar grado 3-4 y troclear grado 2-3. Leve a moderado derrame articular, con leve sinovitis difusa.
Engrosamiento y aumento de señal de la plica patelar medial.
Leve tendinosis proximal del gastrocnemio medial, con pequeña rotura parcial intrasustancia.

original_report:
MRI LEFT KNEE

INDICATION: Pain in the left medial knee ultrasound shows abnormal medial ligament

Routine MRI of the left knee shows a small radial tear at the inner and of the posterior horn of the medial meniscus. Small vertical tear in the body of the lateral meniscus. ACL and PCL are intact. Extensor mechanism is intact. The MCL is intact. Lateral collateral ligaments are intact.

No joint effusion. Tiny Baker's cyst. Mild popliteus bursitis. No cartilage defects in the medial and lateral compartments. Focal severe chondrosis at the apex of the patella with underlying bony edema measuring 12 mm transverse by 8 mm in depth with overlying cartilage irregularity. Trochlear cartilage is intact.

IMPRESSION:

Vertical tears are seen in the inner edges of the medial and lateral menisci. This involves the body of the lateral meniscus and the posterior horn of the medial meniscus.

Severe chondromalacia patella at the patellar apex with underlying bone marrow edema.

original_report: МР находка: Костите, формиращи колянната става са с нормална форма. МР данни за остеохондрална лезия в латералния кондил на тибията – 2 степен. Визуализира се дефект в хрущяла на тибията от латералната ѝ страна и в близост до интеркондиларните еминенции. Вижда се малък отграничен костномозъчен едем субхондрално под описания дефект. Няма обособен костен фрагмент. Кръстните връзки са със запазена цялост. Вижда се дегенеративна промяна в задния рог на медиалния менискус, без данни за руптура. COMPARISON:None.

CLINICAL HISTORY:Medial joint line pain right knee. Pain with plantar twisting. Suspected medial meniscal tear.

PROCEDURE:Multisequence, multiplanar unenhanced MRI of the right knee according to routine protocol.

IMAGING FINDINGS:[

Nondiagnostic scout localizing images reviewed.

Inferiorly surfacing oblique tear posterior horn medial meniscus extending into the body, which is slightly peripherally extruded. Superimposed radial tear at the junction of the posterior horn and posterior root, with displaced 7 x 3 x 6 mm meniscal fragment lying anterior to the posterior root. The anterior horn is intact. The lateral meniscus is intact.

Intact anterior cruciate ligament and posterior cruciate ligament.

The medial collateral ligament, posterior oblique ligament, fibular collateral ligament, popliteus and biceps femoris tendon attachments, as well as iliotibial band are intact.

The patellar retinacula are intact. No femoral trochlear dysplasia. The TT-TG distance measures 5 mm, within normal limits. The quadriceps and patellar tendons are intact.

There is mild to moderate generalized patellofemoral chondrosis. There is mild to moderate medial and lateral femorotibial chondrosis.

Trace knee joint fluid. Regional musculature is within normal limits. No suspicious focal marrow signal alteration. 

IMPRESSION:
1. There is a subsequent complete tear posterior horn and body medial meniscus with radial tear at the junction of the posterior root and posterior horn of the meniscus. 7 mm displaced meniscal fragment anterior to the posterior root of the medial meniscus.
2. Mild to moderate tricompartment chondrosis suggesting evolving mild osteoarthritis of the right knee.

Exam Type: MRI KNEE RIGHT WO CONTRAST
Exam Date and Time: [DATE] [TIME]
Indication: Anterior knee pain after fall approximately one month prior. Assess for occult stress fracture or meniscus tear.
Comparison: [REDACTED].

TECHNIQUE:
MRI of the right knee was performed on a 1.16 Tesla open system with a dedicated knee coil in three planes (axial, sagittal, and coronal), using a standard non-contrast protocol.

FINDINGS:
OSSEOUS STRUCTURES:
No fracture. No suspicious marrow signal abnormality.

JOINT SPACE:
Alignment is anatomic. No joint effusion. No intra-articular body. Trace Baker's cyst.

MEDIAL COMPARTMENT:
Medial meniscus: Increased signal throughout much of the body and posterior horn compatible with diffuse myxoid degeneration. There is a small oblique undersurface tear at the posterior horn near the posterior root with borderline extrusion of the body. No displaced fragment or para meniscal cyst is identified.
Medial compartment cartilage: No focal cartilage defects.

LATERAL COMPARTMENT:
Lateral meniscus: Increased signal at the posterior root attachment not meeting MR chart here for tear, likely representing intrasubstance degeneration. There is borderline extrusion of the body. No displaced fragment or para meniscal cyst is identified.
Lateral compartment cartilage: Mild chondral thinning noted along the weightbearing surface of the lateral femoral condyle near the intercondylar notch.

PATELLOFEMORAL COMPARTMENT:
Patellofemoral compartment cartilage: Small, scattered foci of partial-thickness cartilage loss diffusely noted along the patella. No discrete trochlear defect.

CRUCIATE LIGAMENTS:
Anterior cruciate ligament (ACL): Normal with both bundles intact.
Posterior cruciate ligament (PCL): Normal.

COLLATERAL LIGAMENTS & POSTEROLATERAL CORNER:
Medial collateral ligament (MCL): Normal.
Lateral collateral ligament (LCL) complex: Normal.
Posterolateral corner structures: Normal.

EXTENSOR MECHANISM:
Distal quadriceps tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Patella tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Medial patellofemoral ligament (MPFL) and patellar retinacula: Normal.
Patellofemoral tracking: No edema in superolateral Hoffa's fat pad. No lateral patellar tilt or translation. No patella alta. Normal patellar and trochlear morphology. Normal tibial tubercle-trochlear groove (TT-TG) distance measuring 7 mm.

MUSCLES/TENDONS:
No acute muscle strain or muscle atrophy. Visualized tendons not previously discussed are intact without tendinosis or tear.

SOFT TISSUES:
No soft tissue mass. Normal popliteal neurovascular bundle.

IMPRESSION:

1. Medial meniscus tear as described. Lateral meniscus degeneration without definite tear.

2. Low-grade patellofemoral/lateral compartment chondrosis.

Rotura del menisco medial.

Ligamentos cruzados y colaterales dentro de límites normales.

medial con componente principal radial prácticamente completo con componente horizontal
oblicuo asociado. Leve formación quística parameniscal posterior de 12 x 9 mm en sus ejes
mayores, asociado a perimeniscal a nivel del cuerpo con leve extrusión meniscal.

condral focal de espesor total de la faceta medial de la rótula.
No hay significativo derrame articular ni quistes poplíteos.

tendón rotuliano, sin signos de rotura. Discreto edema el paquete adiposo retro cuadricipital
suprarrotuliano de manera reactiva.
Tendones de la pata de ganso, bíceps femoral y banda iliotibial dentro de límites normales.

Rotura compleja del menisco medial con leve extrusión meniscal y edema de las partes blandas
regionales, previamente descrita.
Condropatía focal grado 2 y 3 de la faceta medial de la rótula.
Leve tendinosis rotuliana proximal y cuadricipital distal con discreto edema del paquete adiposo
retro cuadricipital suprarrotuliano, probablemente reactiva

issues.reason: The report explicitly states 'İç yan bağın yüzeyinde izlenen ödem zorlanmayla ilişkili olabilir' (edema observed on the surface of the medial collateral ligament may be related to strain). This indicates an MCL abnormality (strain/edema), which under the RagSet convention (GOLD_ANALYSIS shows MCL positives exist for such findings) should be labeled as positive. issues.reason: The report states 'Medyal menisküste dejenerastif yapı içi sinyal artışı izleniyor' (degenerative intrameniscal signal increase observed in the medial meniscus). This describes degenerative change (Grade 2 signal), not an explicit tear/rupture. Per RagSet rules extracted from studies, degenerative change or nonspecific intrasubstance signal does not automatically equal a tear. GOLD_ANALYSIS convention must be followed: without explicit tear language, this should be negative.

issues.label: Bakers
issues.reason: The report mentions 'Gastroknemiyus-semimembranozis bursiti sızdırıyor' (gastrocnemius-semimembranosus bursitis leaking/present). This is a bursitis, not a Baker's (popliteal) cyst. Per RagSet rules: 'Suprapatellar/infrapatellar/deep infrapatellar bursitis is not automatically Baker's' and 'Other cysts do not automatically equal Baker's'. A Baker's cyst specifically arises from the popliteal fossa between gastrocnemius and semimembranosus tendons; labeling generic bursitis as Baker's is incorrect.

MRI  KNEE  -  RIGHT

TECHNIQUE:  Unenhanced multiplanar multisequence MR images of the right knee.

CLINICAL INDICATION:  Lateral and medial menisci tear

COMPARISON:  None.

FINDINGS:

The patellar and quadriceps tendons are intact. No retinacular disruption. No trochlear dysplasia. The TT-TG distance is 6 mm, within normal limits. The patellofemoral cartilage is intact.

Chronic complete tear of the anterior cruciate ligament with anterior drawer sign measuring up to 7 mm. The posterior cruciate ligament is intact.

Inferiorly surfacing oblique tear posterior horn medial meniscus extending into the body. MRI RIGHT KNEE:

INDICATION:    Patient reports history of chondroblastoma to the right knee diagnosed in <[YEAR]> but not fully worked up. X-ray in <[Month]> <[YEAR]> confirms nonspecific lytic lesion right patella. Please assess.

PRIOR IMAGING: Plain film radiographs from [Date]
.
TECHNICAL INFORMATION AND PROTOCOL:

Proton density and T2 weighted sagittal, coronal and axial imaging was performed through the knee including a 3D Fat suppressed proton density weighted sequence. No contrast was administered.

FINDINGS:

The 3-D proton density sequence was reformatted and manipulated to aid in the interpretation of this examination.

In the superolateral aspect of the patella there is a T2 bright focus with irregular sclerotic margination seen on the plain film characterized by low signal margination on MRI. This focal lesion has central T2 bright signal similar in signal to articular cartilage and has a linear cartilaginous signal extending posteriorly to the articular surface of patella. The articular cartilage of patella directly posterior to this focus is intact but does demonstrate slight contour irregularity and signal change which may represent mild chondrosis. The finding measures about 1 cm in maximum diameter. The appearance is typical in location and MRI features of a dorsal defect of the patella. This represents a normal anatomic variant.

Articular cartilage of the patellofemoral joint is well-maintained.

The extensor mechanism is intact.

The patellofemoral ligaments are intact and appear unremarkable. The TT-TG distance measures about 1.5 cm, at the upper limits of normal, consistent with an element of mild lateralization of the tibial tubercle

The lateral meniscus is intact. The articular cartilage of lateral joint compartment is well-maintained.

Within the lateral femoral condyle there is a serpiginously marginated lesion measuring 2.1 AP, 1.4 cm with an 0.9 cm in depth situated 2 to 3 mm deep to the cortex of the lateral femoral condyle. The rim of this lesion is T2 bright and T1 dark with central fat. MR features are typical of a bone infarct. No evidence of cortical collapse.

The medial meniscus is intact. The articular cartilage of the medial joint compartment is well-maintained.

The anterior cruciate ligament, posterior cruciate ligament, medial collateral ligament and lateral collateral ligament complex including the IT band, fibular collateral ligament, biceps femoris tendon and popliteus tendon all appear intact and unremarkable.

There is a trace Baker's cyst demonstrated. No significant knee effusion is demonstrated.

A few small subcentimeter popliteal lymph nodes are incidentally noted.

Marrow signal is otherwise normal. No other bone infarcts are seen within field-of-view.

INTERPRETATION: 
Subcortical chondroid focus in the superolateral aspect of patella has MR features typical of a dorsal defect of the patella. The finding is not typical of a chondroblastoma. Mild overlying chondromalacia patella.

Mild lateralization of tibial tubercle.

Trace Baker's cyst.

There is a bone infarct seen in the lateral femoral condyle. No evidence of articular collapse.
Clinical correlation as to the possible cause of a bone infarct in this patient is recommended.

CONSTATATIONS :

Fractures :
Fracture d'avulsion non déplacée de l'épine tibiale au niveau de l'insertion du ligament croisé antérieur avec œdème osseux focal.
Fracture non déplacée du coin postérieur du plateau tibial latéral avec extension intra-articulaire, sans marche d'escalier articulaire. Œdème léger de la moelle osseuse associé.
Œdème osseux focal d'aspect partiellement linéaire sur la face latérale du condyle fémoral latéral portant, représentant une contusion osseuse ou une fracture microtrabéculaire non déplacée.
Œdème osseux linéaire semi-circulaire sur la face médiale du condyle fémoral médial, au niveau de l'origine du LCM, évoquant une fracture d'avulsion non déplacée.
Fracture intra-articulaire non déplacée de la tête du péroné, avec œdème osseux associé, sans déformation de la surface articulaire.

Alignement articulaire :
Normal.

Changements dégénératifs :
Déchirement focal de grade modéré du cartilage rétropatellaire à l'apex patellaire.

Signal de la moelle osseuse :
Par ailleurs, sans particularité.

Ligament croisé antérieur : Signal T2 légèrement augmenté et légère irrégularité à l'insertion distale du fragment osseux de l'épine tibiale avulsé ainsi qu'à l'origine proximale compatible avec une déchirure partielle de bas grade.
Ligament croisé postérieur : Normal.
Ligament collatéral médial : Normal.
Complexe du ligament collatéral latéral : Entorse de bas grade à l'origine proximale du ligament collatéral latéral, déchirure partielle de bas grade à l'origine du tendon du poplité. Le tendon du Biceps femoris et la bandelette iliotibiale sont sans particularité.

Ménisque médial : Normal.
Ménisque latéral : Normal.

Tendons extenseurs : Légère tendinose proximale du tendon patellaire.
Rétinacula patellaire : Normaux.
Pes anserinus : Normal.

Coin postéro-médial et postéro-latéral :
Il y a une lésion du coin postéro-latéral avec des signes de déchirure du fascicule ménisco-poplité inférieur.

Épanchement articulaire : Grand épanchement articulaire avec 2 niveaux de liquide, présentant probablement une lipohémarthrose.
Kyste de Baker : Aucun.

Autres trouvailles significatives :
Entorse musculaire de bas grade à l'origine du muscle gastrocnémien latéral, à la jonction myotendineuse distale du muscle vaste médial, ainsi qu'au muscle poplité.

CONCLUSION :
Fracture avulsion de l'épine tibiale sans déplacement significatif, associée à une déchirure partielle de bas grade du ligament croisé antérieur.
Le signe de fractures supplémentaires non déplacées impliquant le plateau tibial latéral postérieur, le condyle fémoral latéral, la face médiale du condyle fémoral médial sous l'origine du LCM, ainsi que la tête fibulaire comme détaillé ci-dessus.
Entorse de bas grade de la partie proximale du ligament collatéral latéral ainsi que de l'origine du tendon du poplité.
Entorse musculaire de bas grade impliquant l'origine du gastrocnémien latéral, le poplité et la jonction myotendineuse distale du vaste interne.
Signe d'une lésion du coin postéro-latéral avec déchirure du fascicule ménisco-poplité inférieur.

original_report:
Exam Type: MRI KNEE RIGHT WO CONTRAST
Exam Date and Time: [DATE] [TIME]
Indication: pain
Comparison: No relevant prior studies available for comparison.

TECHNIQUE:
MRI of the right knee was performed on a 1.5 Tesla system with a dedicated knee coil in three planes (axial, sagittal, and coronal), using a standard non-contrast protocol.

FINDINGS:
OSSEOUS STRUCTURES:
Alignment is anatomic. No acute fracture or bone bruise. Lobular T2 hyperintense lesion in the right medial distal femoral metaphysis measuring 1.7 x 1.6 x 2.3 cm with with stippled hyperintense signal, compatible with a low-grade chondroid lesion. Background marrow signal is otherwise normal without infiltrative marrow process. No aggressive osseous lesions.

JOINT SPACE:
Trace joint effusion. No intra-articular bodies. Trace Baker's cyst.

MEDIAL COMPARTMENT:
Medial meniscus: Mild myxoid degeneration of the medial meniscus without discrete tear.
Medial compartment cartilage: No focal cartilage defects.

LATERAL COMPARTMENT:
Lateral meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.
Lateral compartment cartilage: High-grade partial-thickness cartilage loss along the posterior lateral tibial plateau. Minimal heterogeneity along the central weightbearing lateral femoral condyle.

PATELLOFEMORAL COMPARTMENT:
Patellofemoral compartment cartilage: Diffuse high-grade partial-thickness cartilage loss along the articular surface with focal full-thickness chondral fissuring along the inferior lateral trochlea.

CRUCIATE LIGAMENTS:
Anterior cruciate ligament (ACL): Normal with both bundles intact.
Posterior cruciate ligament (PCL): Normal.

COLLATERAL LIGAMENTS & POSTEROLATERAL CORNER:
Medial collateral ligament (MCL): Normal.
Lateral collateral ligament (LCL) complex: Normal.
Posterolateral corner structures: Normal.

EXTENSOR MECHANISM:
Distal quadriceps tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Patella tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Medial patellofemoral ligament (MPFL) and patellar retinacula: Normal.
Patellofemoral tracking: Mild edema in superolateral Hoffa's fat pad. Lateral patellar tilt and translation. Patella alta. Normal patellar and trochlear morphology. Top normal tibial tubercle-trochlear groove (TT-TG) distance measuring 17 mm.

MUSCLES/TENDONS:
No acute muscle strain or muscle atrophy. Visualized tendons not previously discussed are intact without tendinosis or tear.

SOFT TISSUES:
No soft tissue mass. Normal popliteal neurovascular bundle.

IMPRESSION:
1.	Findings of lateral patellofemoral maltracking with impingement of Hoffa's fat pad and high-grade patellofemoral chondrosis.
2.	Additional moderate lateral compartment chondrosis.
3.	Low-grade chondroid lesion in the right medial distal femoral metaphysis, for which follow-up MRI is recommended in 6-12 months.

COMMUNICATION FOLLOW-UP: [REDACTED]. [REDACTED]

original_report: MRI knee The following sequences were applied combined with a multichannell phased array coil, in a 3Tesla Scanner: T1, FS PD, T2* and contrast-enhanced FS T1. Menisci, ligamentous structures, bone marrow and articular cartilage do not show any abnormalities. Conclusion The findings suggest bilateral inflammatory arthritis. PS. The findings were confirmed with Ultrasound examination, performed on the same day, which showed the effusion and the synovitis, without however significant hyperemia.

Descartar lesión del menisco externo.

Ligamentos cruzados y colaterales dentro de límites normales.
Aumento de señal central del cuerno posterior del menisco medial que no impresiona contactar
con la superficie articular, sin caracteres propios de rotura.
El menisco lateral impresiona de morfología y señal conservada, sin signos de rotura.
Úlceras condrales de espesor parcial y prácticamente total de la zona de carga del compartimento
femorotibial lateral. Úlceras condrales de espesor parcial de la región central del cóndilo femoral
medial. El resto de los cartílagos femorotibiales sin alteraciones. Cartílago troclear dentro de
límites normales.
Úlceras condrales de espesor total de la faceta lateral de la rótula con cambios óseos
secundarios.
Aumento de señal del aspecto superoexterno de la grasa de Hoffa.
No hay signos que sugieran significativo derrame articular o quistes poplíteos.
Leve aumento de señal del tercio proximal del tendón rotuliano y de la región distal del tendón
cuadricipital, sin signos de rotura. Tendones de la pata de ganso, bíceps femoral y banda iliotibial
dentro de límites normales.
Impresión:
Condropatía con lesiones grado 2 y 3 del compartimento femorotibial lateral. Condropatía con
lesiones grado 2 del cóndilo femoral medial.
Condropatía lesiones grado 4 de la rótula.
Signos de un síndrome de hiperpresión externa de la rótula.
Leve tendinosis rotuliana proximal y cuadricipital distal.

MRI of left Knee with 
-Locator, SG PD FatSat, SG T2W FS, SG T1W, CO T2W FS, AX T2W FS



> The contour of ACL in a straight line and increase signal intensity inside on F/S T2WI, in favor of grade 1 injury or degeneration..
> The contour of PCL appears to be within normal, no abnormal signal intensity is noted.
> Linear signal intensity in  medial meniscus, with extending into the surface of posterior horn of medial meniscus, in favor of tear.
> Linear signal intensity in anterior horn of lateral meniscus, with extending into the surface, in favor of tear.
> Both medial & lateral collateral ligaments appear to be within normal.
> Subchondral bone marrow edema/cysts and irregular thining of intra-articular cartilage over lateral patellofemoral joint and medial femorotibial joint, reflecting osteoarthritis. Subchondral hypointensity line noted on T1WI and F/S T2WI in anterior medial tibial plateau, in favor of small osteonecrosis.
> Joint effusion and suprapatellar bursitis with suprapatellar and thick medial plicae; hypertrophy of the synovium, indicative of synovitis.
> Increased fat stranding  along the pes anserinus, R/O paratendinitis of pes anserinus.
> Tendinosis of quadriceps tendon.
Impression: 
1. Osteoarthrits of left knee , major at lateral patellofemoral joint and medial femorotibial joint.
2. In favor of small osteonecrosis of right anterior medial tibial plateua.
3. Degeneration of meniscus and tear of posterior horn of medial meniscus and anterior horn of lateral meniscus.
4. Mild synovitis of left and and patellar plicae.
5. Grade 1 injury or degeneration of ACL.
6. Subcutanoeous edema over anterior aspect of left knee and mild paratendinitis of pes anserinus.

COLLATERAL LIGAMENTS & POSTEROLATERAL CORNER:

Antecedentes Clínicos:
Obs. Lesión meniscal.
Hallazgos:
No hay alteraciones en significativas de la médula ósea.
Ligamentos cruzados y colaterales dentro de límites normales.
Aumento de señal central del cuerno posterior y parte del cuerpo del menisco medial que
impresiona contactar de manera periférica la superficie articular inferior, puede representar una
pequeña rotura.
Rotura a nivel de la unión de los fascículos poplíteo meniscales del cuerno posterior del menisco
lateral con desplazamiento de segmento hacia parte de la región intercondílea y adyacente al
cuerno anterior del menisco lateral.
Cartílagos del compartimento femorotibial lateral sin alteraciones significativas.
Úlceras condrales de espesor parcial de la región central de la zona de carga del cóndilo femoral
medial con algunos fenómenos condrales reparativos. El resto de los cartílagos del compartimento
femorotibial medial sin alteraciones. Úlceras condrales focales de espesor total de la región central
de la tróclea femoral con cambios óseos secundarios. Cartílago rotuliano dentro de límites
normales.
Leve a moderado derrame articular con discreta sinovitis. Discreto edema a nivel de la esquina
posterolateral de la rodilla sin alteraciones de las principales estructuras regionales.
Tendones cuadricipital, la pata de ganso, bíceps femoral y banda iliotibial dentro de límites
normales. Discreto aumento de señal del tercio proximal del tendón rotuliano, sin signos de rotura.
Impresión:
Rotura de la unión de los fascículos poplíteo meniscales del cuerno posterior del menisco lateral
con desplazamiento de segmento hacia la región intercondílea y adyacente al cuerno anterior del
menisco lateral.
Probable rotura periférica del menisco medial.
Condropatía lesiones grado 2 con fenómenos condrales reparativos de la región central de la zona
de carga del cóndilo femoral medial. Condropatía lesiones focales grado 3 y 4 de la tróclea
femoral.
Leve a moderado derrame articular con discreta sinovitis difusa.
Leve tendinosis rotuliana proximal.

original_report:
MRI of right  Knee with 
-SG PD FatSat, Locator, SG T2W FS, SG T1W, CO T2W FS, AX T2W FS



> The contour of ACL is not in a straight line and increase signal intensity inside, in favor of tear.
>Increased signal intensity of PCL on T1WI, in favor of grade 1 injury.
> There are linear signal intensity in anterior and posterior horn of medial meniscus, it extends into the surface and relatively small size of posterior horn, in favor of tear.
> Linear signal intensity in posterior horn of medial meniscus, without significant extending into the surface, in favor of  grade 2 intrasubstance signal of posterior horn of medial meniscus, maybe due to degeneration.
> Both medial & lateral collateral ligaments appear to be within normal.
> Osteoarthritis of right knee with spur and subchondral cysts and subchondral edema in lateral femoral condyle; wearing of articular caritlage,grade 3-4. 
    Some losse bodies noted in right knee joint.
> Joint effusion and suprapatellar bursitis with suprapatellar and medial and lateral  plicae; hypertrophy of the synovium, indicative of synovitis.

Impression: 
1. C/W tear of ACL.
2. Tear of lateral meniscus and R/O degeneraiton of posterior horn of medial meniscus.
3. Osteoarthritis of right knee with synovitis; more severe at lateral compartment.
4. R/O grade 1 injury of PCL.
Suggest correlation with clinical manifestation

Exam Type: MRI KNEE LEFT WO CONTRAST
Exam Date and Time: [DATE] [TIME]
Indication: Left knee pain since [DATE]
Comparison: No relevant prior studies available for comparison.

TECHNIQUE:
MRI of the left knee was performed on a 1.5 Tesla system with a dedicated knee coil in three planes (axial, sagittal, and coronal), using a standard non-contrast protocol.

FINDINGS:
OSSEOUS STRUCTURES:
Alignment is anatomic. No acute fracture or bone bruise. Background marrow signal is normal without infiltrative marrow process. No aggressive osseous lesions. T1 and T2 hypointense focus in the medial aspect of the tibial metadiaphysis along the cortex, likely an involuted nonossifying fibroma.

JOINT SPACE:
No joint effusion. No intra-articular bodies. No Baker's cyst.

MEDIAL COMPARTMENT:
Medial meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.
Medial compartment cartilage: No focal cartilage defects.

LATERAL COMPARTMENT:
Lateral meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.
Lateral compartment cartilage: No focal cartilage defects.

PATELLOFEMORAL COMPARTMENT:
Patellofemoral compartment cartilage: No focal cartilage defects.

CRUCIATE LIGAMENTS:
Anterior cruciate ligament (ACL): Normal with both bundles intact.
Posterior cruciate ligament (PCL): Normal.

COLLATERAL LIGAMENTS & POSTEROLATERAL CORNER:
Medial collateral ligament (MCL): Normal.
Lateral collateral ligament (LCL) complex: Normal.
Posterolateral corner structures: Normal.

EXTENSOR MECHANISM:
Distal quadriceps tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Patella tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Medial patellofemoral ligament (MPFL) and patellar retinacula: Normal.
Patellofemoral tracking: Severe edema in superolateral Hoffa's fat pad. Lateral patellar tilt. No patellar translation. Mild patella alta. Asymmetry of the trochlear facets. Top normal tibial tubercle-trochlear groove (TT-TG) distance measuring 15 mm.

MUSCLES/TENDONS:
No acute muscle strain or muscle atrophy. Visualized tendons not previously discussed are intact without tendinosis or tear.

SOFT TISSUES:
No soft tissue mass. Normal popliteal neurovascular bundle.

IMPRESSION:
Active lateral patellofemoral maltracking. No patellofemoral chondrosis.

FINDINGS:

Fluid:
Moderate to large knee joint effusion and popliteal cyst. The popliteal cyst measures 2.7 cm x 2.1 cm x 4.2 cm in length. No cyst rupture.

There is osseous intra-articular body in the subpopliteus recess measuring 1.5 cm in total.

Medial compartment (meniscus, collateral ligament, cartilage):
No medial meniscal tear. There is mild to moderate cartilage thinning, which has progressed without full-thickness cartilage loss or reactive subchondral marrow changes. Marginal osteophytes are noted as well as peripheral medial tibial plateau intraosseous ganglion cyst.

Lateral compartment (meniscus, collateral ligament complex, cartilage):
Degenerative multidirectional tearing of the body and posterior horn of the lateral meniscus with a large radial oblique tear at the junction of the body and posterior horn. There is progression of the tear with further loss of substance when compared to previous MRI.
Severe chondropathy in the lateral compartment with full-thickness cartilage thinning, reactive subchondral marrow changes and osteophytes which have progressed.
Lateral supporting structures intact.

Intercondylar compartment (anterior and posterior cruciate ligaments):
Normal.

Anterior compartment (extensor mechanism, cartilage, Hoffa's fat pad):
Mild cartilage thinning at the patellar medial and lateral facet as well as the trochlear surface, with a full-thickness cartilage fissure at the lateral patellar facet and mild reactive subchondral marrow changes. Marginal osteophytes also noted. Extensor mechanism is intact

Bones:
As above

Muscles and neurovascular structures:
Normal.

Other findings:
None

CONCLUSION:

Tricompartmental chondropathy, severe in the lateral compartment, which have progressed. Osseous intra-articular body in the subpopliteus recess.

Multidirectional tearing of the lateral meniscus the body and posterior horn, which has progressed. Large radial oblique tear at the junction of the body posterior horn.

Moderate to large knee joint effusion and popliteal cyst.

ACL intact.

femorotibijalnog i femoropatelarnog zgloba uz osteofitozu zglobnih tijela, subtotalno, mjestimice
i potpuno reduciranu debljinu zglobnih hrskavica te vidljiv subhondralni edem zglobnih tijela. U
anteriornom dijelu tibije vidljivo je i nekoliko subhondralnih cisti degenerativne etiologije.
Zglobna tijela FT zgloba primjereno su uzglobljena. Visoki položaj patele (patella alta),
Insall-Salvati omjer oko 1,8.
Prednji križni ligament je izrazito degenerativno promijenjen, smanjene napetosti, vjerojatno
uslijed suženja zglobnog prostora, bez jasnih znakova rupture.
Stražnji križni ligament je primjerenih intenziteta signala i održanog kontinuiteta.
Medijalni menisk je stanjen, degenarativno promijenjen uz horizontalnu rupturu stražnjeg

Degenerativno promijenjen lateralni menisk, bez znakova rupture.
Medijalni i lateralni kolateralni ligamenti su primjerenih intenziteta signala, održanog kontinuiteta.
Edem periligamentarno uz MCL, vjerojatno uslijed OA promjena.
Uredan prikaz tetive popliteusa, iliotibijalnog trakta i pes anserinus.
Tetiva kvadricepsa i patelarni ligament su primjerenih intenziteta signala, održanog kontinuiteta.
Patelarni retinakulumi održani.
Umjerena količina izljeva u zglobu.
Baker cista veličine oko 17 mm.
Prepatelarno edem potkožnog masnog tkiva.

Normal.

None.

МР находка: Костите, формиращи лявата колянна става, са с нормална форма и сигнален интензитет. Наличие на минимален ставен излив. Артикулиращият хрущял на фемура и тибията е със запазена дебелина и конгруентност.
МР данни за лезия в задния рог на латералния менискус. В него се изобразяява хиперинтензна линия с хоризонтален ход, съответстваща на скъсване. Руптурата достига до края на менискуса и се проследява в тялото му и частично в предния му рог. Предният рог на латералния менискус е с дифузно повишен сигнал. Целият латерален менискус е експулсиран встрани. Между него и латералния колатерален лигамент са налице едемни промени в мастната тъкан. МР данни за частична увреда в задния рог на медиалния менискус. В него се вижда хиперинтензна линия с кос ход, не достигаща до артикулиращите повърхности на тибията и фемура. Нормален МР образ на предния рог на медиалния менискус.
Кръстни връзки – със запазена цялост. Вижда се частична увреда на латералния колатерален лигамент. Същият е задебелен и с дифузно повишен сигнален интензитет на инсерцията си за фемура, като измененията са на протежение от около 10-11мм. Медиален колатерален лигамент – б.о. Лигамент на пателата, сухожилие на м. квадрицепс феморис – без особености. Нормално изобразяване на пателата. Вижда се малък дефект от медиалната страна на хрущяла на пателата. Дефектът не достига до костта и е с размери 2,5/2,0 мм. Ретинакулуми на пателата – със запазена цялост. Поплитеална ямка – наличие на мултилокуларна Бекерова киста с типично местоположение и размери 44/37/16 мм. Мускулни групи, останали меки тъкани – нормално изобразяване. Заключение:  МР данни за хоризонтална руптура в задния рог на латералния менискус - grade 3. Дегенеративни промени в предния рог на латералния менискус. Частична увреда на задния рог на медиалния меднискус – grade 2a. Увреда на латералния колатерален лигамент – grade 1.  Минимален ставен излив. Хондромалация на пателата – grade 3. Мултилокуларна Бекерова киста с типично местоположение.

Discreto foco edema óseo en relación a la superficie articular tibio peroneo proximal de la tibia,

colaterales sin alteraciones que consignar.

posterior del menisco medial con segmento que se insinúa a la región intercondílea posterior.

Cartílagos de los compartimentos femorotibiales y de la tróclea femoral sin alteraciones. Condropatía
superficial la faceta medial de la rótula.
Leve derrame articular. Ganglión quístico polilobulado de la región posterosuperior de la rodilla, en íntima
relación con el receso gastrocnemio medial semimembranoso, no complicado.
Tendones cuadricipital, la pata de ganso, bíceps femoral y banda iliotibial dentro de límites normales.
Aumento de señal del tercio proximal del tendón rotuliano, sin signos de rotura.

Aumento de señal con probable pérdida parcial de la continuidad las fibras centrales del LCA, correlacionar

Posteromedyal köşe yapıları bunun dışında korunmuş. Ekstensör mekanizma korunmuş. Proksimal tibyofibular eklem normal.

original_report: МР находка: МР данни за ставен излив, най-вероятно хеморагичен. МР данни за скъсване на предната кръстна връзка. Връзката е със силно уголемен напречник и силно повишен интензитет на сигнала. Находката е както при субтотална руптура. Интактна е задната кръстна връзка, Костите, формиращи колянната става са с нормалн а форма и сигнален интензитет. МР данни за лезия на задния рог на медиалния менискус – 2a. В задния рог на менискуса се вижда хиперинтензна линия с хоризонтален ход, достигаща до края на менискуса. Нормално изобразяване на латералния менискус. Вижда се частично скъсване на медиалния колатералвен лигамент. Този лигамент е с висок интензитет на сигнала, оточен и задебелен. Нормално изобразяване на латералния колатерален лигамент. Визуализира се частично скъсване на медиалния фемуропоплитеален лигамент (MPFL). Ставният хрущял на фемура, тибията и пателата е интактен. Лигамент на пателата и сухожилие на мускулус квадрицепс феморис- нормално изобразяване. Заключение: МР данни за субтотална руптура на предната кръстна връзка. Частично скъсване на  медиалния колатерален лигамент и медиалния фемуропоплитеален лигамент (MPFL). Хеморагичен ставен излив.

Right knee MRI without contrast:

INDICATION: Rule out right knee meniscal tear.

COMPARISON: No prior for comparison.

FINDINGS:

No significant effusion. No loose body.

Anterior compartment:
Overall mildly chondrosis with small fissures on the lateral and medial facets of the patella less than 50% of the thickness. Area of subchondral sclerosis on the lateral facet. Patellar and quadriceps tendons intact. Retinacula are intact. Hoffa fat pad unremarkable.

Medial compartment:
Mild chondrosis. Presence of a small meniscal flounce in the anterior body of medial meniscus without definitive tear. Capsular meniscal interface intact. Medial collateral ligament intact. Pes anserine unremarkable. Moderate insertional tendinopathy within the semimembranosus tendon.

Lateral compartment:
Mild chondrosis no significant meniscal tear. Lateral collateral ligament intact. Biceps femoris tendon intact. Iliotibial band intact. Popliteus tendon is intact.

Intercondylar compartment:
Mild cystic changes within the tibial eminence and mild high signal intensity within the anterior cruciate ligament and could be in keeping with intraligamentous beginning degenerative mucoid changes. Posterior cruciate ligament intact.

Multiple varicose veins on the medial aspect of the knee in the subcutaneous tissues.

CONCLUSION:
1. Mild to moderate patellofemoral chondrosis.
2. Semimembranosus insertional tendinosis without tear. No discrete ligament or meniscal tear identified.
3. Multiple varicose veins to the medial aspect of the knee in the subcutaneous tissue.

original_report:
MRI LEFT KNEE:

INDICATION:    [Age] male complaining of left knee pain and swelling. Ultrasound shows focal tear of the lateral collateral ligament versus ligament sprain and likely tear of the medial and lateral meniscus. Joint effusion in the suprapatellar recess and Baker's cyst. Recommended by radiologist.

PRIOR IMAGING: None.
.
TECHNICAL INFORMATION AND PROTOCOL:

Proton density and T2 weighted sagittal, coronal and axial imaging was performed through the knee including a 3D Fat suppressed proton density weighted sequence. No contrast was administered.

FINDINGS:

The 3-D proton density sequence was reformatted and manipulated to aid in the interpretation of this examination.

There is mild thickening and increased T2 signal in the proximal fibers of the patellar tendon. Findings are consistent with mild patellar tendinosis. Quadriceps and patellofemoral ligaments are intact and appear unremarkable.

The articular cartilage of the patellofemoral joint demonstrates mild chondral fraying at the patellar apex and also within the femoral trochlea but overall cartilage is reasonably well-maintained. The TT-TG distance is within normal limits.

There is mild non-surfacing signal seen in the posterior horn of medial meniscus peripherally. Involving posterior horn near the posterior root attachment of medial meniscus there is mild apical truncation and fraying of the meniscus consistent with a subtle radial tear. The articular cartilage of the medial joint compartment demonstrates regions of chondral fraying and thinning with a few subcortical cysts seen within the weightbearing surface of the medial femoral condyle in keeping with moderate chondrosis.

There is a subtle tear in the lateral meniscus involving anterior horn and anterior body in keeping with the radial tear in this region. There is also a horizontal signal in keeping with a horizontal tear extending into the anterior horn of lateral meniscus. The articular cartilage of the lateral joint compartment demonstrates chondral fraying and thinning but is reasonably well-maintained. Findings are consistent with moderate chondrosis. Minimal degenerative spurring to the lateral joint compartment is noted.

The anterior cruciate ligament, posterior cruciate ligament, medial collateral ligament and lateral collateral ligament complex including the IT band, the fibular collateral ligament, the biceps femoris tendon and popliteus tendon all appear intact and unremarkable.

There is a small Baker's cyst. There is edema and fluid seen around the pes anserine tendons consistent with pes anserine bursitis.

There is a small knee effusion. Mild reactive synovitis is noted.

Marrow signal is within normal limits.

INTERPRETATION: 

Mild tricompartmental chondrosis with early degenerative spurring to the lateral joint margin.

Subtle meniscal tears to the lateral and medial menisci as described.

Small Baker's cyst.

Pes anserine bursitis.

Exam Type: MRI KNEE RIGHT WO CONTRAST
Exam Date and Time: [DATE] [TIME]
Indication: Right knee pain. [REDACTED]. Patellar dislocation. Prior history of MCL grade 3 sprain and patellar dislocation (less severe) in [DATE] and [DATE]
Comparison: No relevant prior studies available for comparison.

TECHNIQUE:
MRI of the right knee was performed on a 1.5 Tesla system with a dedicated knee coil in three planes (axial, sagittal, and coronal), using a standard non-contrast protocol.

FINDINGS:
OSSEOUS STRUCTURES:
Alignment is anatomic. Mild marrow edema along the peripheral aspect of the lateral femoral condyle, likely represents contusion from a recent lateral patellar dislocation. Background marrow signal is normal without infiltrative marrow process. No aggressive osseous lesions.

JOINT SPACE:
Moderate joint effusion. No intra-articular bodies. No Baker's cyst.

MEDIAL COMPARTMENT:
Medial meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.
Medial compartment cartilage: No focal cartilage defects.

LATERAL COMPARTMENT:
Lateral meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.
Lateral compartment cartilage: No focal cartilage defects.

PATELLOFEMORAL COMPARTMENT:
Patellofemoral compartment cartilage: Cartilage heterogeneity along the median patellar ridge and lateral patellar facet.

CRUCIATE LIGAMENTS:
Anterior cruciate ligament (ACL): Normal with both bundles intact.
Posterior cruciate ligament (PCL): Normal.

COLLATERAL LIGAMENTS & POSTEROLATERAL CORNER:
Medial collateral ligament (MCL): Normal.
Lateral collateral ligament (LCL) complex: Normal.
Posterolateral corner structures: Normal.

EXTENSOR MECHANISM:
Distal quadriceps tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Patella tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Medial patellofemoral ligament (MPFL) and patellar retinacula: Low grade 2 sprain of the MPFL and medial patellar retinacula.
Patellofemoral tracking: Edema in superolateral Hoffa's fat pad. Lateral patellar tilt and translation . Patella alta configuration. Normal patellar and trochlear morphology. Top normal tibial tubercle-trochlear groove (TT-TG) distance measuring 19 mm.

MUSCLES/TENDONS:
No acute muscle strain or muscle atrophy. Visualized tendons not previously discussed are intact without tendinosis or tear.

SOFT TISSUES:
No soft tissue mass. Normal popliteal neurovascular bundle.

IMPRESSION:
1.	Findings of patellofemoral maltracking with osseous contusion along the lateral femoral condyle suggesting a recent lateral patellar dislocation, as described above.
2.	Low grade 2 sprain of the MPFL and medial patellar retinacula.
3.	Moderate knee joint effusion.
4.	Low-grade patellofemoral compartment chondrosis.

MRI RIGHT KNEE:

INDICATION:Right knee lateral pain gradual onset, pain in patellar tendon and lateral posterior knee as well, positive McMurray very test, rule out meniscal tear, also suspicious for hamstring tendinitis/patellar tendinitis.

PRIOR IMAGING: None available.
.
TECHNICAL INFORMATION AND PROTOCOL:

Proton density and T2 weighted sagittal, coronal and axial imaging was performed through the knee including a 3D Fat suppressed proton density weighted sequence. No contrast was administered.

FINDINGS:

The 3-D proton density sequence was reformatted and manipulated to aid in the interpretation of this examination.

The extensor mechanisms are intact; the patellar tendon is homogenously hypointense without evidence of inflammation. The patellar cartilage at the facet of the lateral femoral condyle appears enlarged with heterogenous enhancement consistent with low-grade/grade I chondromalacia patella. The trochlear cartilage is intact. Visualized hamstring tendons of the biceps for Morris, semitendinosus and semimembranosus appear unremarkable. The patellar soft tissues are normal.

The TT-TG distance measures 8 mm, within normal limits.

The anterior cruciate, posterior cruciate, medial collateral and lateral collateral stabilizes, fibular collateral collateral ligament, popliteus, biceps femoris tendon and iliotibial tendons, appear intact. No measurable anterior tibial translation.

Lateral and medial menisci appears intact. Articular cartilage of the lateral and medial femoral condyles are intact.

Small knee joint effusion. No Baker's cyst.

Marrow signal normal. 

INTERPRETATION: 
Mild chondromalacia of the lateral patellar femoral condyle facet.

Patellar tendon and biceps femoris tendons appear unremarkable, without evidence of tendinitis.

MRI of right Knee with 
-Locator, SG PD FatSat, SG T2W FS, SG T1W, CO T2W FS, AX T2W FS



Large osteophytes and irregular thining of intra-articular cartilage of right knee, reflecting osteoarthritis
Wearing of articular cartilage of femoral trochlea with deep fissure and subchondral bone marrow edema, reflecting grade 3-4 chondromalacia.
Thin articular cartilage of lateral facet of lower patella. reflecting grade 3 chondromalacia.
Focal increased signal intensity in subchondral region of posterior medial femoral condyle and fibular head on F/S T2WI, R/O intraosseous hemangioma; differential diagnosis of focal bone marrow edema.
Joint effusion and suprapatellar bursitis with suprapatellar, lateral and medial plicae; hypertrophy of the synovium, indicative of synovitis.

> The contour of ACL in a straight line and increase signal intensity inside on F/S T2WI, in favor of grade 1 injury or degeneration and synovial interposition.
> The contour of PCL, MCL and LCL within normal, no abnormal signal intensity is noted.
> No evidence of tear is noted in either medial or lateral meniscus.
> Both medial & lateral collateral ligaments appear to be within normal.
> Mild subcutanoeus edema over right knee.

Impression: 
1. Osteoarthritis of right knee with grade 3-4 chondromalacia.
2. R/O intraosseous hemangioma in right posterior medial femoral condyle and right fibular head (Srs/Img: [ID]; differential diagnosis of bone marrow edema.
3. Moderate synovitis- joint effsuion  of right knee.
4. R/O grade 1 injury or degeneration of ACL; differential diagnosis of synovial interposition over distal ACL.
Suggest correlation with clinical manifestation

issues.label: ACL
issues.reason: The report explicitly states 'in favor of grade 1 injury or degeneration' of the ACL with increased signal intensity. Under the RagSet convention (GOLD_ANALYSIS), a grade 1 ACL injury/sprain is mapped to ACL=1. The R/O language applies to the differential between injury vs degeneration/synovial interposition, not to the presence of an ACL abnormality itself.

issues.label: Medial_OA
issues.reason: The report describes 'Large osteophytes and irregular thinning of intra-articular cartilage of right knee, reflecting osteoarthritis' and 'Focal increased signal intensity in subchondral region of posterior medial femoral condyle... R/O intraosseous hemangioma; differential diagnosis of focal bone marrow edema.' This reflects generalized knee OA and a focal medial femoral condyle lesion of uncertain etiology (hemangioma vs edema), not confirmed medial compartment osteoarthritis. No explicit medial compartment OA (medial tibiofemoral cartilage loss, medial osteophytes, medial joint space narrowing) is described. Generalized OA cannot be automatically mapped to Medial_OA=1 per Model 2 OA Rule.

This is a lateral compartment patellofemoral cartilage abnormality. Under the RagSet convention (GOLD_ANALYSIS), lateral patellar facet chondromalacia/wear maps to Lateral_OA=1 (lateral compartment OA includes lateral patellofemoral involvement). The Model 2 OA Rule requires explicit compartment identification, which is present here: 'lateral facet of lower patella'.

issues.label: Contusion
issues.reason: The report describes 'Focal increased signal intensity in subchondral region of posterior medial femoral condyle and fibular head... differential diagnosis of focal bone marrow edema.' Bone marrow edema in the subchondral region of the posterior medial femoral condyle, in the context of osteoarthritis, is consistent with a bone contusion/bone bruise pattern. GOLD_ANALYSIS shows Contusion=1 in 19/58 cases, and the Model 2 Explicit-Evidence Override supports labeling explicit bone marrow edema/contusion findings as Contusion=1 when supported by context. The R/O hemangioma does not negate the presence of bone marrow edema.

original_report: МР находка: МР данни за ставен излив с белези на хемартроза. Костите, формиращи колянната става, са с нормална форма. Наличие на костномозъчен едем в латералния кондил на фемура и в постеролатералното тибиално плато. Ставният хрущял е съхранен. Отграничен подкожен едем по предната повърхност на подбедрицата. МР данни за пълна руптура на предна кръстна връзка. Връзката е със силно задебелен напречник, с дезорганизирани влакна и с дифузно повишен сигнален интензитет. Задната кръстна връзка е интактна. Колатерални лигаменти – със запазена цялост. Патела, хрущял на пателата – б.о. Ретинакулуми на пателата – б.о. МР данни за дегенеративна промяна в задния рог на латералния менискус. В него се изобразява къса хиперинтензна линия с кос ход, не достигаща до артикулиращите повърхности на фемура и тибията. Нормално изобразяване на предния рог на латералния менискус и на медиалния меснискус. Сухожилие на м. квадрицепс феморис, лигамент на пателата – нормално изобразяване. Поплитеална ямка – б.о. Заключение: МР данни за ставен излив с данни за хемартроза. Костно-мозъчен едем на фемура и тибията. Руптура на предната кръстна връзка. Дегенеративни промени в задния рог на латералния менискус – stage 2a.

IMAGING FINDINGS:

Nondiagnostic scout localizing images reviewed.

The lateral meniscus is intact.

Nearly complete tear posterior horn medial meniscus, extending into the body, which is slightly peripherally extruded. Bilobed 12 x 5 x 3 mm parameniscal cyst adjacent to the posterior horn near the posterior. The anterior horn is intact.

Intact anterior cruciate ligament and posterior cruciate ligament.

The medial collateral ligament and posterior oblique ligament are intact. The iliotibial band is intact. Popliteus and biceps femoris tendon attachments are intact. 

No patellofemoral subluxation. The patellar retinacula are intact. Millimeters, within normal limits.

The quadriceps and patellar tendons are intact.

There is thinning of patellofemoral articular cartilage. There is fissuring and thinning of lateral femorotibial articular cartilage. There is thinning of medial femorotibial articular cartilage.

Trace knee joint fluid. Regional musculature is within normal limits. No suspicious focal marrow signal alteration.

IMPRESSION:
1. Inferiorly subtle oblique tear posterior horn medial meniscus extending into the body, which is slightly peripherally extruded. Adjacent parameniscal cyst.
2. Mild to moderate tricompartment chondrosis suggesting evolving mild osteoarthritis of the left knee.

MRI RIGHT KNEE:

INDICATION:    assess mpfl tear, osteochondral fragment   .

PRIOR IMAGING:    
.
TECHNICAL INFORMATION AND PROTOCOL:

Proton density and T2 weighted sagittal, coronal and axial imaging was performed through the knee including a 3D Fat suppressed proton density weighted sequence. No contrast was administered.

FINDINGS:

The 3-D proton density sequence was reformatted and manipulated to aid in the interpretation of this examination.

The patella is laterally subluxed and there is diffuse edema seen along the course of the medial patellofemoral ligament consistent with a high-grade injury. This extends to the femoral attachment and also involves the attachment at the patella. The lateral patellar retinaculum is intact and appears unremarkable.

There is intraosseous edema within the medial patella and contour flattening of the medial surface of the patella. There is associated edema in the lateral femoral condyle consistent associated with the osteochondral impaction along the lateral cortical surface in keeping with transient lateral dislocation of the patella associated with osteochondral impaction of the medial surface of the patella and lateral femoral condyle.

The quadriceps and patellar tendons are intact.

There is trochlea dysplasia and lateralization of the tibial tubercle with the TT-TG distance measuring 2.1 cm. Articular cartilage of the patella demonstrates focal fraying at the patellar apex. The trochlear surface is reasonably well-maintained.

The lateral meniscus is intact. The articular cartilage of the lateral joint compartment appears to be well maintained.

The medial meniscus is intact. The articular cartilage of the medial joint compartment is well-maintained.

The anterior cruciate ligament is intact and appears unremarkable.

There is mild intrinsic signal within the posterior cruciate ligament but intact fibers are present and the signal changes may in part be artifactual.

There is edema around the proximal and mid fibers of the medial collateral ligament consistent with low-grade medial collateral ligament sprain.

The lateral collateral ligament complex including fibular collateral ligament, biceps femoris tendon, popliteus tendon and IT band all appear intact and unremarkable.

There is a small to moderate knee effusion. There is no Baker's cyst demonstrated.

INTERPRETATION: 

Torn medial patellofemoral ligament associated with bone contusions an osteochondral fracturing of the medial surface of patella and lateral femoral condyle associated with transient dislocation of the patellofemoral joint.

Moderate chondromalacia patella.

Background changes of lateralization of the tibial tubercle and shallowness of the trochlear groove predisposing to patellar dislocation.

Low-grade medial collateral ligament tear.

Nonspecific signal in the posterior cruciate ligament favored to be artifactual.

original_report:
Exam Type: MRI KNEE RIGHT WO CONTRAST
Exam Date and Time: [DATE] [TIME]
Indication: Posterior knee pain, tripped [DATE] on sidewalk
Comparison: Right knee radiographs 11/[DATE]

TECHNIQUE:
MRI of the right knee was performed on a 3.0 Tesla system with a dedicated knee coil in three planes (axial, sagittal, and coronal), using a standard non-contrast protocol. A marker was placed at the site of reported symptoms.

FINDINGS:
OSSEOUS STRUCTURES:
Alignment is anatomic. No acute fracture or bone bruise. Background marrow signal is normal without infiltrative marrow process. No aggressive osseous lesions.

JOINT SPACE:
No joint effusion. No intra-articular bodies. No Baker's cyst. Ganglion cyst associated with the popliteus tendon sheath extending into the popliteus muscle.

MEDIAL COMPARTMENT:
Medial meniscus: Thin complete radial tear of the posterior root of the medial meniscus within 1 cm of the attachment. Mild extrusion and displacement into the meniscotibial recess. Mild edema at the meniscocapsular attachment likely reflecting a low-grade strain.
Medial compartment cartilage: No focal cartilage defects.

LATERAL COMPARTMENT:
Lateral meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.
Lateral compartment cartilage: No focal cartilage defects.

PATELLOFEMORAL COMPARTMENT:
Patellofemoral compartment cartilage: No focal cartilage defects.

CRUCIATE LIGAMENTS:
Anterior cruciate ligament (ACL): Attenuated consistent with prior sprain.
Posterior cruciate ligament (PCL): Normal.

COLLATERAL LIGAMENTS & POSTEROLATERAL CORNER:
Medial collateral ligament (MCL): Periligamentous edema, presumably related to adjacent meniscal pathology.
Lateral collateral ligament (LCL) complex: Normal.
Posterolateral corner structures: Normal.

EXTENSOR MECHANISM:
Distal quadriceps tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Patella tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Medial patellofemoral ligament (MPFL) and patellar retinacula: Normal.
Patellofemoral tracking: No edema in superolateral Hoffa's fat pad. No lateral patellar tilt or translation. No patella alta. Normal patellar and trochlear morphology. Normal tibial tubercle-trochlear groove (TT-TG) distance measuring 11 mm.

MUSCLES/TENDONS:
No acute muscle strain or muscle atrophy. Visualized tendons not previously discussed are intact without tendinosis or tear.

SOFT TISSUES:
No soft tissue mass. Normal popliteal neurovascular bundle. Benign-appearing lymph node in the popliteal fossa.

IMPRESSION:
1. Thin complete radial tear of the posterior root of the medial meniscus with mild extrusion and displacement into the meniscotibial recess.

2. Probable associated low-grade meniscocapsular sprain.

3. Attenuated anterior cruciate ligament presumably related to prior sprain.

ADDENDUM:
Moderate trochlear chondrosis with areas of high-grade partial and full-thickness cartilage loss at the central trochlea with subchondral edema.

original_report: Zur MR-VU von 05/16 nochmals progrediente Stigmata der medial betonten Panonarthrose mit osteophytären Anbauten aller Gelenkpartner sowie insbesondere im medialen Kompartiment progredienter flächiger vollschichtiger Chondropathie mit korrespondierend geringem Knochenmarksödem in der medialen Femurkondyle sowie dem medialen Tibiaplateau. Ebenfalls progrediente Chondropathie mit höhergradig geminderten Knorpelbesatz und V. a. fokal vollschichtige Chondropathie der lateralen Femurkondyle (4/23). Ebenfalls höhergradig geminderter Knorpelbesatz der Trochlea mit teils flächiger vollschichtiger Chondropathie. Teils höhergradige fokale, chondrale Läsionen auch retropatellar (8/10). Chondrale Osteophyten an der medialen Patellarückseite. Komplexe Rissbildung des Innenmeniskus in der Pars intermedia sowie dem Hinterhorn mit nach paratibial disloziertem Lappenriss (4/23). Außenmeniskus ohne Anhalt für eine Rissbildung. VKB mukoid. HKB intakt. MCL und LCL intakt. Akzentuierte Gelenkflüssigkeit. Lobulierte, flüssigkeitsgefüllte Baker-Zyste mit einer CC-Ausdehnung von ca. 7,8 cm. Quadriceps- sowie Patellarsehne mit intakter Darstellung. Die miterfassten Weichteile in den vorliegenden Sequenzen mit unauffälliger Signalgebung.

original_report: ΤΕΧΝΙΚΗ Η εξέταση έγινε με ακολουθίες παλμών Τ1, πυκνότητας πρωτονίων με καταστολή του σήματος του λίπους και Τ2 βαθμιδωτής ηχούς. ΔΕΞΙΟ ΓΟΝΑΤΟ Οι χιαστοί και πλάγιοι σύνδεσμοι απεικονίζονται εντός του φυσιολογικού.  Συλλογή υγρού παρατηρείται ενδαρθρικά σε επικοινωνία με ευμεγέθη συνοβιακή κύστη Baker, κεφαλουραίας διαμέτρου 7,5cm. Ο οστικός μυελός παρουσιάζει καλοήθη υπερπλασία. Στο έξω διαμέρισμα του γόνατος παρατηρείται εκφυλιστική οστεοαρθρίτιδα με σοβαρή διάβρωση του αρθρικού χόνδρου του μηριαίου κονδύλου και της κνήμης ICRS STAGE III. Συνυπάρχει εκφυλιστική ρήξη του μηνίσκου και παρουσία επιχείλιων οστεοφύτων και μικρής εστίας υπαρθρικού οστεομυελικού οιδήματος στον έσω κνημιαίο επικόνδυλο. Από τον έλεγχο του έσω διαμερίσματος παρατηρούνται μόλις υποσημαινόμενες εκφυλιστικές αλλοιώσεις με μικρά επιχείλια οστεόφυτα και ρωγμώδη διάβρωση του αρθρικού χόνδρου του έσω μηριαίου κονδύλου. Από τον έλεγχο του πρόσθιου διαμερίσματος παρατηρούνται ευρήματα εκφυλιστικής οστεοαρθρίτιδας με διάβρωση του αρθρικού χόνδρου της έξω αρθρικής επιφάνειας ICRS STAGE II και της έσω αρθρικής επιφάνειας ICRS STAGE IV. Η επιγονατίδα έχει μορφολογία Wiberg II και σε συνδυασμό με την αβαθή τροχιλία προδιαθέτει σε δυσλειτουργια κύλισης. Συνυπάρχει προεπιγονατιδική ορογονοθυλακίτιδα.
