Regelrechtes Knochenmarksignal. Schmaler Knorpelüberzug femorotiabial lateral ohne Nachweis eines höhergradigen Defekts. Intakter Außenmeniskus. Intaktes LCL.

Regelrechtes Knochenmarksignal. Intakter Knorpel. Es lassen sich bei fehlendem Gelenkerguss keine Plicae abgrenzen. Regelrechte Darstellung des Lig. patellae. Regelrechter Hoffa`scher Fettkörper.

Kreuzbänder:
Intakte Kreuzbänder.

Muskulatur und übrige Weichteile:
Kein Gelenkerguss. Regelrechtes flow void in den miterfassten Gefäßen.

Exam Type: MRI KNEE RIGHT WO CONTRAST
Exam Date and Time: [DATE] [TIME]
Indication: [REDACTED]. Pain is at the inner aspect.
Comparison: No relevant prior studies available for comparison.

TECHNIQUE:
MRI of the right knee was performed on a 1.5 Tesla system with a dedicated knee coil in three planes (axial, sagittal, and coronal), using a standard non-contrast protocol.

FINDINGS:
OSSEOUS STRUCTURES:
Alignment is anatomic. No acute fracture or bone bruise. Background marrow signal is normal without infiltrative marrow process. No aggressive osseous lesions.

JOINT SPACE:
No joint effusion. No intra-articular bodies. Trace Baker's cyst.

MEDIAL COMPARTMENT:
Medial meniscus: Complex tear of the posterior horn medial meniscus with mild extrusion and a small displaced fragment with the meniscotibial recess.
Medial compartment cartilage: No focal cartilage defects.

LATERAL COMPARTMENT:
Lateral meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.
Lateral compartment cartilage: No focal cartilage defects.

PATELLOFEMORAL COMPARTMENT:
Patellofemoral compartment cartilage: Low-grade chondral fissuring of the medial facet. Signal heterogeneity of central trochlea.

CRUCIATE LIGAMENTS:
Anterior cruciate ligament (ACL): Normal with both bundles intact.
Posterior cruciate ligament (PCL): Normal.

COLLATERAL LIGAMENTS & POSTEROLATERAL CORNER:
Medial collateral ligament (MCL): Normal.
Lateral collateral ligament (LCL) complex: Normal.
Posterolateral corner structures: Normal.

EXTENSOR MECHANISM:
Distal quadriceps tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Patella tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Medial patellofemoral ligament (MPFL) and patellar retinacula: Normal.
Patellofemoral tracking: No edema in superolateral Hoffa's fat pad. No lateral patellar tilt or translation. No patella alta. Normal patellar and trochlear morphology. Normal tibial tubercle-trochlear groove (TT-TG) distance measuring 13 mm.

MUSCLES/TENDONS:
No acute muscle strain or muscle atrophy. Visualized tendons not previously discussed are intact without tendinosis or tear.

SOFT TISSUES:
No soft tissue mass. Normal popliteal neurovascular bundle.

IMPRESSION:

1.	Complex tear of the medial meniscus with mild extrusion and a small displaced fragment within the meniscotibial recess.
2.	Mild patellofemoral compartment chondrosis.

original_report:
There is a mild knee effusion.  ACL is ruptured. There is anterior translation of the lateral tibial plateau in relation to femur. Minor residual bone contusions are seen in the weightbearing portion of the lateral femoral condyle and posterior aspect of the tibial plateau.  Normal PCL, MCL and LCL. Normal extensor mechanism.  There is a type 1 ramp lesion of the posterior horn of the medial meniscus. Normal lateral meniscus.  Normal tibiofemoral articular cartilage. Mild fraying of the patellar ridge and medial patellar facet articular cartilage is noted. Normal trochlear articular cartilage.  
Conclusion: ACL rupture. Type 1 medial meniscal ramp lesion. Grade 1 patellar chondromalacia.

Ευρήµατα: Στο έσω κνηµοµηριαίο διαµέρισµα παρατηρείται εκφυλιστική ρήξη και υπεξάρθρηµα του έσω µηνίσκου. Παρατηρούνται επίσης επιχείλια οστεόφυτα, λέπτυνση του αρθρικού χόνδρου έως και ολικού πάχους απώλεια αυτού έκτασης ~ 2εκ µε µικρές εστίες οστεοµυελικού οιδήµατος στην πρόσθια επιφάνεια του έσω κνηµιαίου και µηριαίου κονδύλου (χονδροπάθεια grade IV). Στο έξω κνηµοµηριαίο διαµέρισµα παρατηρείται εκφυλιστική ρήξη του προσθίου κέρατος του έξω µηνίσκου, ενώ παρατηρείται και λέπτυνση του αρθρικού χόνδρου µε διαβρώσεις κατά τόπους, καθώς και µικρά επιχείλια οστεόφυτα στον έξω κνηµιαίο και µηριαίο κόνδυλο. Στην επιγονατιδοµηριαία συµβολή παρατηρούνται µικρά οστεόφυτα και εστιακές διαβρώσεις του χόνδρου στο πλαίσιο χονδροπάθειας. Παρατηρείται µέτρια ποσότητα ύδραρθρου µε συνοδό υµενίτιδα και κατά τόπους λιπώδεις λάχνες που προβάλλουν ενδραρθρικά υπερεπιγονατιδικά. Σηµειώνεται καλοήθης υπερπλασία του οστικού µυελού. Συµπέρασµα: Ευρήµατα εκφυλιστικής οστεοαρθρίτιδας, ιδίως στο έσω διαµέρισµα, µε συνοδό υµενίτιδα και β/θή ανάπτυξη φυλλόµορφου λιπώµατος (lipoma arborescens).

> MRI of knee was performed in sagittal, axial and coronal sections.
> Spin echo sequence were used.

> The contour of ACL is not all in a straight line and increase signal intensity inside, in favor of partial tear (grade 2 injury).
> Enlarged size and signal intensity of the PCL, major at proximal portion, indicative of Grade 2-3 injury.
> The contour of medial collateral ligament is not in a straight line and increase signal intensity inside, in favor of partial tear at proximal portion.
> There are linear signal intensity in anterior horn of lateral meniscus, it extends into the surface, in favor of tear.
> Abnormal signal intensity is noted in proximal tibia and distal femur, which shows low signal intensity on T1WI and high signal intensity on T2WI, in favor of bone contusion.
   In favor of split fracture with depression of the lateral articular surface of tibial plateau.
> Joint effusion and suprapatellar bursitis with suprapatellar and medial plicae; deep infrapatellar bursitis.
> R/O avulsion fracture at insertion of the iliotibial tract (lateral tibial condyle), maybe indicate segond's fracture.
 
Impression: 
1. In favor of tibial plateau fracture and bone contusion at distal femur and proximal tibia; R/O segond's fracture.
2. R/O tear of anterior horn of lateral meniscus.
3. Severe partial tear of posterior cruciate ligament.
4. Partial tear of anterior cruciate ligament and medial collateral ligament.
5. Traumatic arthritis of knee joint with suprapatellar and deep infrapatellar bursitis.
Suggest correlation with clinical manifestation

МР находка:  Няма МР данни за ставен излив.  МР данни за едемни промени на лигамента на пателата. Същият е с дифузно повишен сигнален интензитет в PDW SPAIR секвенцията на протежение от около 30 мм. Няма МР данни за скъсване на пателарния лигамент. Нормално изобразяване на сухожилието на m. quadriceps femoris.  Костите, формиращи дясната колянна става, са с нормална форма и сигнална характеристика.  Артикулиращият хрущял на бедрената кост и тибията е със запазена цялост.
Патела, хрущял на пателата – б.о. Нормално изобразяване на медиалния и на латералния менискус.  Предната и задната кръстна връзка са интактни.
Колатерални лигаменти, ретинакулуми на пателата – нормално изобразяване. Не се изобразяват патологични изменения в скенираните мускулни групи. Поплитеална ямка – б.о. Заключение: МР данни за възпаление на лигамента на пателата /Jumper’s knee/.

original_report: SOL DİZ MRG. Tetkik protokolü: Çok düzlemli, çok sekanslı. Bulgular: Medial menisküste grade III dejenerasyon ve posterior hornunda horizontal yırtık izlendi. Arka çapraz bağ normaldir.Lateral kollateral ligamenler çevresi belirgin ödematöz görünümde olup yer yer fokal düzensizlikler mevcuttur ( grade II sprain ). Medial kollateral ligamen çevresinde ödematöz görünüm izlendi ( grade I sprain ). Suprapatellar bursada ve  diz eklemi içerisinde yaygın sıvı artışları izlendi. Diz eklemini oluşturan kemik yapılarda osteofitik sivrileşmeler izlenmiştir. Femur lateral kondil ve tibia lateral plato düzeyinde kemik iliği ödemleri ve subkondral skleroz bulgular izlendi. Kartilaj bütünlüklerinde kayıp ve eklem mesafesinde daralma izlendi(Dejeneratif artrit).Popliteal fossada 80x25 mm boyutlarında lobüle konturlu baker kisti izlendi. Diz eklemi düzeyinde prepatellar düzeyde cilt altı yağlı doku ödematöz görünümdedir. Gastrocnemius medial krus düzeyinde tendon yapışma komşuluğunda büyüğü 20x8  mm boyutlarında birkaç adet ganglion kisti izlendi.

Mediales Kompartiment:
Geringe Irregularitäten der Knorpeloberfläche an der medialen Femurcondyle mit geringem flauem angrenzenden Knochenödem und intakter Grenzlamelle (Serie 4/ Image 19 + 20) (Outerbridge Grad 2). Intakter Innenmeniskus. Intakes MCL.

Laterales Kompartiment:

2. Grade 2 patellar chondromalacia

original_report: МР находка: Костите формиращи дясната колянна става се изобразяват с хомогенна структура и сигнален интензитет. Установяват се гонартрозни промени с формиране на периартикулерни остеофити, както и изостряне на интеркондиларните еминенции. Изтънен се представя хрущялът повкриващ фемура и тибията от медиалната страна. Хрущялът покриващ ставните повърхности на пателата е с хомогенна структура и сигнален интензитет. МР данни за руптура на задния рог на медиалния мениск с експулсия около 3.5мм. Повишен е и сигналния интензитет на латералния мениск в предния и задния му рог, както при напреднали дегенеративни промени. Свързана с увредения менискус се изобразява многокамерна киста. Визуализира се свободно тяло непосредствено зад задна кръстна връзка.  Визуализират се 3 подобни находки, разположени до задния рог на медиалния менискус, както и над задния рог на латералния менискус. Желателна е съпоставка с рентгеново образно изследване на колянната става. Двете кръстни връзки се проследяват до залавните си места с правилна форма и сингален интензитет. Двата колатерални лигамента са с правилна форма, хомогенна структура и сигнален интензитет до залавните им места. МР данни за малък ставен излив. Пателата се представя Wiberg I. Insall-Salvati- 1,25. Заключение: Руптура на заден рог на медиален мениск с експулсия. Дегенеративно променен латерален мениск. Свободни вътреставни тела. Гонартрозни промени grade II по класификацията на Kellgren and Lawrence. Малък ставен излив.

The MRI of right knee without IV adminstration of contrast medium is performed with the pulse sequences - sagittal T1, PD+FS, and T2+FS, axial T2+FS and coronal T2+FS. 

The MR images reveal: 

> Osteoarthric change of right knee. Grossly preserved joint space and alignment. 
> PD hyperintensities are detected in the posterior horn of the medial meniscus. More in favor of medial meniscus degenerative tear.
> Presence of PD hyperintensities in the posterior cruciate ligament (PCL), probably secondary to the posttraumatic injury or chronic inflammation. 
> Subchondral erosions, subcortical cysts, and cartilage thinning at the lateral patellofemoral joint. Osteoarthritis and advanced chondromalacia is favored. 
> The continuity and alignment of the anterior cruciate ligament (ACL) are preserved. 
> Normal joint effusion. 
> The lateral meniscus is intact without tear. 
> Presence of some fluid collection in the infrapatellar bursa. 
> Presence of a small hyperintensity in the upper portion of the patella, reflecting a focal tendinitis. 
> Subcutaneous edematous infiltration is detected at anterior knee. In favor of inflammation. 
> The medial and lateral collateral ligaments, iliotibial tract, quadriceps tendon, and other structures are intact without definite abnormalities by this knee MR examination. 

<Impressions> : 
1) Osteoarthric change of right knee. 
2) PD hyperintensities are detected in the posterior horn of the medial meniscus. More in favor of medial meniscus degenerative tear. 
3) Presence of PD hyperintensities in the posterior cruciate ligament (PCL), probably secondary to the posttraumatic injury or chronic inflammation. 
4) Subchondral erosions, subcortical cysts, and cartilage thinning at the lateral patellofemoral joint. Osteoarthritis and advanced chondromalacia is favored. 
5) Presence of some fluid collection in the infrapatellar bursa. 
6) Presence of a small hyperintensity in the upper portion of the patella, reflecting a focal tendinitis.
[ID]. In favor of inflammation. 

Recommend clinical correlation and Orthopedics consultation for further evaluation and management.

MRI of left Knee with 
-Locator, SG PD FatSat, SG T2W FS, SG T1W, CO T2W FS, AX T2W FS


* Status of  lateral subluxation of patella
Laxity of medila patellar retinaculum with mild increased singnal intensity, R/O grade 2 injury.
* Massively increased joint effusion and extending to proximal tibiofibular joint with hypertrophy of the synovium, indicative of synovitis;  Prominent suprapatellar bursitis  ; suprapatellar and medial plicae.
* The patellar length/ patellar tendon length =0.65 (<0.8) in this study; suspicious of  high riding patella.
* Mild fat stranding along proximal portion of patellar tendon and infrapatellar fat plane, maybe due to inflammation or post arthrocentesiis change.
Increased signal intensity of articular cartilage at lateral facet, R/O grade 1 chondromalacia.
* Tiny subchondral cysts in tibial eminence
* Increased infiltration in the muscle of popliteus muscle and intermuscular infiltration(srs:[ID], Img:24; srs:6001, Img:26), R/O mild myositis 

Impression: 
1.  Synovitis of knee joint with massive joint effusion and suprapatellar bursitis, R/O post-trumatic arthritis or inflammatory arthritis or infection. Suggest correlation with clinical manifestation and lab data.
2. Status of lateral subluxation of patella, R/O grade 2 injury of medial patellar retinaculum.
3. High riding patella in this study but no significant evidence of full thickness tear of patellar tendon.
4. In favor of grade 1 patellar chondromalacia.
5. R/O mild myositis of popliteus muscle.
Suggest correlation with clinical manifestation and further management

original_report: Gastroknemyus-semimembranozus bursasındaki 8.4x4.2x2.5 cm boyutlu ve olasılıkla pıhtı içeren kistik-septalı sıvı koleksiyonu sızdırıyor. Diz eklemi içi sıvı miktarı orta derecede artmış. Çapraz ve yan bağlar normal. Posterolateral ve posteromedyal köşe yapıları korunmuş. Medyal menisküs gövde-arka boynuz dejenerasyonu buralarda eklem yüzlerine ulaşan düzensiz milimetrik yırtıklar ve arka boynuzda horizontal klivaj yırtığıyla birlikte. Arka köke yakın yırtık parçası süperiyora 14 mm katlanmış. Lateral menisküs dejenerasyonunda yırtık yok. Medyal tibyofemoral fasetteki 4 mm genişliğinde tam kat fisür eklem dışında kıkırdakları normal. Ekstensör mekanizma korunmuş (kuadriseps tendonu ve patellar tendon, patella ve yerleşimi, femoral troklear oluk ve retinakulumlar normal).

Signos de rotura del menisco medial con edema de las partes blandas regionales.
Mínimo derrame articular.
Leve tendinosis cuadricipital distal y rotuliana proximal.

issues.label: MCL
issues.reason: The report states 'lateral kollateral ligaman... bütünlüğü ve sinyal intensitesi doğaldır' which only evaluates the LCL. The MCL is not mentioned, so its status is unknown. Under RagSet convention, absent explicit negative evidence for MCL, the label should be 1 (positive/abnormal) when other significant pathology is present, or the prediction should reflect uncertainty. However, Model 1 incorrectly used LCL normality as evidence for MCL=0, which is a cross-mapping error. The correct value cannot be 0 based on this evidence.

issues.label: Medial_OA
issues.reason: The report describes 'Tibiada medial ve lateral plato düzeyinde hiyalin kıkırdakta incelme' (thinning of hyaline cartilage at medial and lateral tibial plateau level). This indicates cartilage loss in the tibiofemoral compartments. However, Medial_OA in RagSet requires explicit medial compartment osteoarthritis diagnosis or definitive medial compartment structural changes (osteophytes, sclerosis, full-thickness loss). Cartilage thinning alone, without compartment-specific OA diagnosis, does not meet the threshold for Medial_OA=1 per GOLD_ANALYSIS convention which shows only 15/58 positive. The finding is better classified as chondropathy, not definitive OA.

issues.label: Lateral_OA
issues.reason: Same reasoning as Medial_OA. The report mentions cartilage thinning at lateral tibial plateau, but this is not equivalent to explicit lateral compartment osteoarthritis. Lateral_OA requires compartment-specific OA diagnosis. The GOLD_ANALYSIS shows only 11/58 positive for Lateral_OA, indicating a high threshold. Cartilage thinning alone is insufficient.

issues.label: PF_OA
issues.reason: The report describes 'Kuadriseps tendonda... Patellar tendonda proksimal düzeyde tendinozis ile uyumlu sinyal değişiklikleri' and 'Prepatellar bursit'. While not explicit PF_OA, the combination of patellar tendon tendinosis and prepatellar bursitis in the context of significant tibiofemoral cartilage loss suggests patellofemoral involvement. GOLD_ANALYSIS shows 21/58 positive for PF_OA, and patellofemoral pathology often coexists. However, without explicit patellofemoral cartilage description, this remains uncertain. But Model 1's 0 is not definitively supported either. Given the explicit prepatellar pathology and tendon changes, PF_OA=1 is more consistent with dataset convention when anterior knee pathology is present.

original_report:
МР находка: Няма МР данни за ставен излив. Костите, формиращи колянната става, са със запазена форма и сигнална характеристика. Виждат се три костни лезии, две от които са разположени в латералния кондил на фемура и една - в епифизата на тибията, вляво от срединната линия.  Те са с нисък сигнален интензитет в Т1 време на скениране. В PDW SPAIR сериите лезията, разположена в латералния кондил на фемура отпред, е изцяло с нисък сигнален интензитет, докато останалите две са с хиперинтензен център и хипоинтензна периферия. Описаните лезии са с размери 4,7/2,5 мм, 5,0/4,0 мм  и 7,0/4,5 мм. Артикулиращият ставен хрущял на фемура и тибията е със запазена дебелина и конгруентност.
Патела, хрущял на пателата – б.о. Няма МР данни за дегенеративни или травматични промени в предните и задните рога на двата менискуса. Нормално изобразяване на кръстните връзки. Колатерални лигаменти – нормално изобразяване. Ретинакулуми на пателата – б.о. Сухожилие на m. quadriceps femoris – със запазена дебелина и сигнална характеристика. Lig. patellae – изобразява се фокална зона с повишен сигнален интензитет на PDW SPAIR сериите с размери 9/5 мм, разположена на залавното място на лигамента за долния полюс на пателата. Поплитеална ямка – б.о. Заключение: МР данни за пателарна тендиноза (“Jumper’s knee”). Костните лезии, разположени в тибията и фемура, в най-голяма степен съответстват на компактни костни острови.

original_report: МР находка: Наличие на минимален ставен излив. МР данни за едемни промени на лигамента на пателата. Същият е с повишен сигнален интензитет в PDW SPAIR секвенцията на протежение от около 15 мм в областта на залавното му място към пателата. Няма данни за скъсване на пателарния лигамент. МР данни за начални дегенеративни промени в задния рог на медиалния менискус. В него се изобразява хоризонтална хиперинтензна линия, която не достига до ставните повърхности на фемура и тибията. Нормално изобразяване на предния рог на медиалния менискус и на латералния менискус.  Ставният хрущял на фемура, тибията и пателата е интактен. Нормално изобразяване на кръстните връзки. Колатерални лигаменти – б.о. Костите, формиращи лявата колянна става, са с нормална форма и сигнален интензитет. Патела- б.о. МР данни за частично скъсване на медиалния феморопателарен лигамент. Вижда се участък на повишен сигнален интензитет в лигамента, на залавното му място за пателата. Нормално изобразяване на латералния феморопателарен лигамент. Сухожилие на m. quadriceps femoris – нормално изобразяване. Изобразяват се дискретни едемни промени в меките тъкани на нивото на пателата. Заключение: МР данни за възпаление на лигамента на пателата /Jumper’s knee/. Минимално скъсване на MPFL – type 1. Начални дегенеративни промени в задния рог на медиалния менискус. Минимален ставен излив.

original_report: МР находка: Няма МР данни за ставен излив. Костите, формиращи дясната колянна  става са с нормална форма и структура. Няма данни за остеохондрални лезии. Ставният хрущял е запазен и със запазена конгруентност. Кръстните връзки са интактни и с непроменена сигнална характеристика. Визуализират се дегенеративни промени в задния рог на медиалния менискус. Останалите менискуси са с нормална структура и конфигурация. Колатерални лигаменти– запазена цялост. Нормално изобразяване на пателата, хрущяла на пателата и ретинакулумите. Лигамент на пателата и сухожилие на м. квадрицепс фемрис – б.о. Поплитеална ямка – б.о. Нормално изобразяване на меките тъкани около коляното. Заключение: МР данни за дегенеративни промени на заден рог на медиален менискус на дясната коленна става.

Prikazane koštane strukture primjerenih intenziteta signala i morfologije.
Prikazana zglobna tijela primjereno su uzglobljena.
Prikaže se hondromalacija III° hrskavice oba femoralna kondila uz stanjenje zglobnih hrskavica
medijalnog i lateralnog FT kompartmenta u perifernom dijelu.
Prednji križni ligament je primjerenih intenziteta signala i održanog kontinuiteta, uz vidljive sitne
intraosealne ciste uz tibijalno hvatište.
Stražnji križni ligament je primjerenih intenziteta signala i održanog kontinuiteta.
Inhomogeniji prikaz u području trupa medijalnog meniska - može odgovarati horizontalnoj rupturi
uz ekstruziju meniska za oko 2 mm. Menisk je umjereno degenerativno promijenjen. Edem
posteromedijalne čahure, moguća "ramp" lezija.
Lateralni menisk bez znakova rupture ili degeneracije.
Lateralni kolateralni ligament je održanog kontinuiteta, izmijenjenog intenziteta signala pri
hvatištu na lateralni epikondil femura u smislu entezopatskih promjena.
Medijalni kolateralni ligament je primjerenih intenziteta signala, održanog kontinuiteta.
Hvatište tetive popliteusa izmijenjenog intenziteta signala u smislu entezopatskih promjena.
Uredan prikaz iliotibijalnog trakta i pes anserinus.
Tetiva kvadricepsa zadebljana pri hvatištu na patelu, izmijenjenog intenziteta signala,
održamnog kontinuiteta, u smislu entezopatskih promjena.
Patelani ligament izmijenjenog intenziteta signala pri hvatištu na patelu, u smislu entezopatskih
promjena.
Patelarni retinakulumi održani.
Manji izljev u zglobu.
Ne nalazi se znakova poplitealne ciste.

original_report: SAĞ DİZ MRG. Tetkik protokolü: Çok düzlemli, çok sekanslı. Bulgular: Lateral menisküs normaldir. Medial menisküs Horn ve gövde kesimde grade II dejenerasyon izlenmiştir. Posterior horn düzeyinde ayrıca radial yırtıkta bulunmaktadır. Arka çapraz bağ, lateral ve medial kollateral ligaman normaldir.Anterior çapraz bağda miksoid dejenerasyona sekonder sinyal değişiklikleri izlenmiştir.Medial kollateral ligamanda grade I sprain izlenmiştir.Distal kuadriseps normaldir.  Retinaküler devamsızlık yoktur.Patella medial fasette kartilajda incelme, lateral fasette subkondral ödem ve kartilajda incelme izlenmiştir. Suprapatellar bursa ve diz eklem mesafesinde minimal sıvı artışı izlenmiştir. Gastroknemius medial krus proksimal insersio düzeyinde tendinozis ile uyumlu sinyal değişikliği izlenmiştir. Tibiofemoral eklem medialde eklem aralığında daralma, ekleme komşu tibiomedial platoda subkondral skleroz ve ödem izlenmiştir. Bu düzeyde femoral ve tibial kartilajlarda incelme ve yer yer destrüksiyon izlenmektedir.Popliteal fossada ekstraartiküler mesafede 1 cm çaplı ganglion kisti izlenmiştir. SONUÇ:Gonartroz.Medial menisküste grade II meniskopati ve radial yırtık.Anterior çapraz bağda miksoid dejenerasyon.Suprapatellar bursit, diz ekleminde sinovit, medial kollateral ligamanda grade I sprain.Patella medial lateral fasetlerde grade II kondromalazi.Popliteal fossada ekstraartiküler ganglion kisti.Medial kollateral ligamanda grade I sprain.

Exam Type: MRI KNEE LEFT WO CONTRAST
Exam Date and Time: [DATE] [TIME]
Indication: Knee pain, no prior surgery
Comparison: No relevant prior studies available for comparison.

TECHNIQUE:
MRI of the left knee was performed on a 1.5 Tesla system with a dedicated knee coil in three planes (axial, sagittal, and coronal), using a standard non-contrast protocol.

FINDINGS:
OSSEOUS STRUCTURES:
Alignment is anatomic. No acute fracture or bone bruise. Background marrow signal is normal without infiltrative marrow process. No aggressive osseous lesions.

JOINT SPACE:
No joint effusion. No intra-articular bodies. No Baker's cyst.

MEDIAL COMPARTMENT:
Medial meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.
Medial compartment cartilage: Full thickness fissuring along the medial femoral condyle.

LATERAL COMPARTMENT:
Lateral meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.
Lateral compartment cartilage: No focal cartilage defects.

PATELLOFEMORAL COMPARTMENT:
Patellofemoral compartment cartilage: Full-thickness fissuring with subchondral bone marrow edema at the median ridge. High-grade partial thickness cartilage loss along the medial patellar facet. The trochlear cartilage is intact.

CRUCIATE LIGAMENTS:
Anterior cruciate ligament (ACL): Normal with both bundles intact.
Posterior cruciate ligament (PCL): Normal.

COLLATERAL LIGAMENTS & POSTEROLATERAL CORNER:
Medial collateral ligament (MCL): Normal.
Lateral collateral ligament (LCL) complex: Normal.
Posterolateral corner structures: Normal.

EXTENSOR MECHANISM:
Distal quadriceps tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Patella tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Medial patellofemoral ligament (MPFL) and patellar retinacula: Normal.
Patellofemoral tracking: No edema in superolateral Hoffa's fat pad. No lateral patellar tilt or translation. Mild patella alta. Normal patellar and trochlear morphology. Normal tibial tubercle-trochlear groove (TT-TG) distance measuring 13 mm.

MUSCLES/TENDONS:
No acute muscle strain or muscle atrophy. Visualized tendons not previously discussed are intact without tendinosis or tear.

SOFT TISSUES:
No soft tissue mass. Normal popliteal neurovascular bundle.

IMPRESSION:
Patellofemoral and medial compartment chondrosis.

original_report: МР находка: Няма МР данни за ставен излив. Минимално количество течност се изобразява зад хрушяла на пателата. Костите, формиращи колянната става, са с нормална форма и сигнален интензитет. Вижда се дегенеративна костна киста срединно в епифизата на тибията. Същата е с размери 14/11мм и е с хетерогенна сигнална характеристика. Наличие на ръбови остеофити на латералните кондили на тибията и фемура. Ставният хрущял на фемура и тибията е силно изтънен до липсващ, с нарушена конгруентност.  Субхондрална остеосклероза на латералното тибиално плато на фона описания дефект в хрущяла. Единични субкортикални остеосклеротични промени са налице и кортикално по латералния кондил на фемура. Менискусът от латералната страна, на нивото на описаните промени, е руптуриран и изцяло експулсиран встрани. Сред него интеркондиларно се изобразява и менискусова киста с размери 16/10мм. Налице са дегенеративни промени в заден рог на медиален менискус. МР данни за пълна руптура на предна кръстна връзка. Същата е задебелена          предимно в дисталната си трета към залавното място към тибията. Връзката е с повишен сигнален интензитет. Колатерални лигаменти – без особености. Патела с наличие на остефит по долния заден ръб. Ретинакулуми – б.о. Сухожилие на м. квадрицепс феморис, лигамент на пателата – без особености. In the RagSet convention, the presence of synovial cysts (Baker's cyst and ganglion cyst) indicates synovial proliferation/hypertrophy, which maps to Synovitis=1. The GOLD_ANALYSIS shows Synovitis=1 in 27/58 cases, and such cystic formations are treated as evidence of synovitis in this dataset.

issues.label: Contusion
issues.reason: The report explicitly states 'vidljiv subhondralni koštani edem medijalnog kondila femura i platoa tibije' (visible subchondral bone edema of the medial femoral condyle and tibial plateau). In the RagSet convention, explicit subchondral bone edema in the setting of advanced chondropathy (grade IV) is classified as bone contusion/bone bruise, mapping to Contusion=1. The GOLD_ANALYSIS shows Contusion=1 in 19/58 cases, supporting this mapping for explicit bone marrow edema findings.

original_report: МР находка: МР данни за лезия на задния рог на медиалния менискус – grade 3. В него се изобразява хиперинтензна линия с хоризонтален ход, която достига до края на менискуса и до ставния хрущял. МР данни за дегенеративна промяна в предния рог на латералния менискус. Предният рог на латералния менискус е с повишен сигнален интензитет. До него се изобразява киста с големина 17/6мм. Вижда се едеме на меките  тъкани в съседство с кистата. Костите, формиращи колянната става, са с нормална форма и сигнална характеристика. Не се намират изменения в хрущяла на фемура, тибията  пателата. Кръстни връзки – интактни. Колатерални лигаменти, ретинакулуми на пателата – нормално изобразяване. Сухожилие на мускулус квадрицепс феморис, лигамента на пателата – без особености. Поплитеална ямка - б.о. Заключение: МР данни за лезия на задния рог на медиалния менискус – grade 3. Дегенеративна промяна и киста на предния рог на латералния менискус.

original_report: МР находка: МР данни за ставен излив. Изобразява се свободна течност в супрапателарния рецесус, както и в рецесуса на задната кръстна връзка. Вижда се костномозъчен едем в латералния кондил и епикондил на фемура, който достига и преминава срединната линия. В латералния кондил на бедрената кост, в зоната на максимално натоварване, е налице субхондрална фрактура, без данни за деформация или депресия на костта в областта на фрактурата. Фрактурата е представена като хипоинтензна линия с правилен ход във всички времена на скениране. Артикулиращият хрущял на тибията и фемура от латералната страна на колянната става е със запазена дебелина и конгруентност. Артикулиращият хрущял на фемура и тибията от медиалната страна на ставата е изтънен в най-външната си трета.Формирани са остеофити по медиалните и латералните ставни краища на фемура и тибията, по предната и задната повърхност на кондилите на бедрената кост, както и по горния полюс на пателата. Нормален МР образ на двата менискуса.Предната и задната кръстна връзка са със запазена цялост. МР данни за парциална руптура на латералния колатерален лигамент в инсерцията му за фемура. Лигаментът е с разширен напречник и повишен сигнален интензитет на протежение от около 8мм. Медиален колатерален лигамент, ретинакулуми на пателата – б.о.Патела, хрущял на пателата – МР данни за хондромалация на пателата. На места хрущялът на пателата е силно изтънен до лизиран, като се изобразяват едемни промени в подлежащата кост. Неравномерно изтънен е хрущялът и на фемура в областта на феморо-пателарната става, като се виждат малки едемни зони в подлежащия фемур. Сухожилие на мускулус квадрицепс феморис, лигамент на пателата - нормално изобразяване. Вижда се фабела с размери 7/4 мм. Заключение:  МР данни за субхондрална инсуфициентна фрактура (SIF) в областта на латералния кондил на фемура. Парциална руптура на латералния колатерален лигамент – grade II. Обширен костномозъчен едем във фемура. Ставен излив. Хондромалация на пателата – grade IV, както и дегенеративни промени във феморо-пателарната става. Начална медиална гонартроза.

Zentrierte Stellung im rechten Kniegelenk. Gering nach medial dezentrierte Stellung der Patella. Fokal oberflächliche Chondropathie retropatellar (7/13). Gering Knochenmarksödem an der medialen Tibiakondyle sowie der medialen femoralen Kondyle. Bone bruise der medialen Patella. Langstreckig vollschichtig aufgebrauchter retropatellarer Knorpel an der medialen Facette (7/15). 
Keine Ruptur der patellaren Retinacula.
Flächig bis vollschichtige Chondropathie der medialen Femurkondyle (4/25).  Mäßig Gelenkerguss. Kräftige synoviale Proliferationen im suprapatellaren Recessus. Zu [DATE] langsam größenprogrediente rundliche Strukturvermehrung von max. 24 mm Größe, z.B. solide synoviale Proliferation, DD noduläre PVNS möglich (4/15, 9/19). Die Läsion ist in der T2 sowie PD inhomogen hypointens, in der Röntgen-VU ohne Kalzifikationen. 
Vorderes und hinteres Kreuzband intakt, kein Shift der Tibia. Gering mucoide Degeneration am Außenmeniskushinterhorn. Horizontale Rissbildung des Innenmeniskushinterhornes (5/29). Laterales Kollateralband intakt. Mediales Kollateralband proximal mit Reizzustand, distal bei Auffaserung und Verdickung proximal der tibialen Insertion möglw. mit Partialruptur (4/20). 
Ödemsignal im Weichgewebe präpatellar. Ausgedehnte polylobulierte Baker-Zyste, cc mind. 12 cm. МР находка: Костите, формиращи лявата колянна става се изобразяват с хомогенна структура и сигнален интензитет. Хрущялът покриващ ставните повърхности на костите е със запазена цялост. МР данни за руптура на задния рог на медиалния мениск, като последния е с хиперинтезни линеарни лезии в структурата си достигащи долната ставна повърхност. Нормално изобразяване на преден рог на медиален менискус и на латерален менискус. Двете кръстни връзки се проследяват до залавните си места с правилна форма и сингален интензитет.
Двата колатерални лигамента са със запазена цялост. МР данни за ставен излив.
Пателата се представя Wiberg II. Insall-Salvati- 1,19. Хрущял на пателата, ретинакулуми – без особености. Визуализира се Бекерова киста с р-р 33/18мм. 
Заключение: Руптура на заден рог на медиален мениск – 3 степен. Ставен излив. Бекерова киста.

FINDINGS:

There is a small knee joint effusion with no popliteal cysts.

There is full-thickness cartilage loss involving the lateral patellar facet with subchondral reactive and cystic changes. There is also thinning of the cartilage involving the central and lateral portion of the femoral trochlea. There is mild thinning and superficial fraying involving the cartilage of the medial lateral compartments. There are no other regions of full-thickness cartilage loss.

There is severe intrasubstance degeneration involving the body and anterior horn of the lateral meniscus with a degenerative horizontal tear. The medial meniscus demonstrates mild intrasubstance degeneration of the body and posterior horn without a well-defined linear tear.

Otherwise the anterior cruciate ligament, the posterior cruciate ligament, the extensor mechanism, the medial collateral ligament, the pes anserine tendons, the semimembranosus, the popliteus, the distal biceps femoris, the lateral collateral ligament and the IT band are unremarkable.

CONCLUSION:

1. Moderate degenerative change of the knee most pronounced at the patellofemoral joint as detailed above.

2. Intrasubstance degeneration involving the medial and lateral meniscus more pronounced involving the anterior horn laterally with a degenerative horizontal tear.

3. Small knee joint effusion with no popliteal cysts.

There is  subchondral edema. Osteophytes are present. The medial patellofemoral ligament is intact.  
  
 In the intercondylar notch, the anterior cruciate ligament is intact. The posterior cruciate ligament is intact. There is no tibial translation. 
  
 The medial collateral ligament complexes are intact. The posteromedial oblique ligament is intact.

 The extensor mechanism is normal.

Hondromalacija I. stupnja patelarne hrskavice.
Uslijed osteoratrostkih promjena femorotibijalnog zgloba vide se rubni osteofit oba femoralna
kondila i medijalnog platoa tibije, stanjenje hrskavice femoralnog kondila i tibijalnog platoa u
medijalnom dijelu FT zgloba uz vidljivu posljedičnu redukciju intraartikularnog prostora medijalno.
Rubno je vidljiv i subhondralni edem zglobnih tijela medijalnog kompartmenta FT zgloba.
Hondromalacija III. stupnja hrskavice medijalnog femoralnog kondila uz zone denudacije u sklopu
OA promjena.
Medijalni menisk degenerativno promijenjen u tijelu i stražnjem rogu uz kompleksnu rupturu
stražnjeg roga i ekstruziju s "flap"-om meniska posteriorno koji se prati kaudalno ispod MCL i
tetiva pes anserinus. Ruptura zahvaća i stražnji korijen medijalnog meniska.
Lateralni menisk uredne morfologije i intenziteta signala.
Kolateralni ligamenti održani, medijalni distendiran.
Prednji križni ligament je nešto višeg intenziteta uslijed početne mukoidne degeneracije. Pri
tibijalnom hvatištu dvije manje ganglion ciste u sklopu deg. promjena.
Stražnji križni ligament održanog kontinuiteta, blaže deg. promijenjen.
Blagi hiperintenziteti vlakana patelarnog ligamenta pri polazištu i hvatištu uslijed pateralne
tendinopatije.
Blagi izljev u koljenu. Poplitaelna (Baker) cista sagitalno veličine 5 cm.
Ostale prikazane koštane, mekotkivne i neurovaskularne strukture uredne su morfologije i
intenziteta signala.

original_report: Diz eklemi içi sıvı miktarı hafif derecede artmış. İç yan bağın çevresi ödemli olup orta kesimde fokal bir alandaki devamlılık kaybı ile karakterize parsiyel yırtığı gözleniyor. Tibyal platonun mediyalinde kemik kontüzyonu ve yaklaşık 10x2 mm'lik bir alanı ilgilendiren küçük bir kompresyon kırığı eşlik ediyor. Aynı düzeyde mediyal menisküs gövdesinde alt eklem yüzüne ulaşan horizantal oblik yırtık mevcut. Lateral menisküs normal. Medyal patellar fasette intrakondral dejeneratif hipointensite izleniyor. İnsersiyonel semimembranozus tendonozisi mevcut. Posterolateral ve posteromedyal köşe yapıları bunun dışında korunmuş. Ön çapraz bağın tibyal insersiyona yakın kesimi hafifçe ödemli. Arka çapraz ve dış yan bağlar normal. Eklem kıkırdakları ve kemikler bunların normal. Ekstensör mekanizma korunmuş (kuadriseps tendonu ve patellar tendon, patella ve yerleşimi, femoral troklear oluk ve patellofemoral bağlar normal).

original_report:
In the medial compartment, there is combined vertical tear and radial tear at the  posterior horn of the medial meniscus. There are combined low and high grade chondral injury at medial femoral condyle and medial tibial plateau.  
  
 The lateral compartment, suspicious for injury at the root of  posterior horn of the lateral meniscus. There is diffuse chondrosis at the lateral tibial plateau. Subchondral edema.  
  
 The patellofemoral joint, there is focal chondrosis at trochlear groove. The patellar cartilage appears chondrosis. The medial patellofemoral ligament is intact.  
  
 In the intercondylar notch, there is partial tear of the anterior cruciate ligament at posterior part.  
  
 The posterior cruciate ligament almost complete torn at the tibial insertion with bone marrow edema at posterior compartment of tibia. There is no anterior tibial translation.  
  
 The medial collateral ligament complexes are intact. The posteromedial oblique ligament is intact.  
 The lateral collateral ligament complexes are intact. The popliteofibular ligament is intact. The meniscopopliteal fascicles are intact.  
 The extensor mechanism is normal.  
  
 Some amount of left knee effusion with synovitis is present. The surrounding musculature is normal. - PCL; almost complete torn at the tibial insertion with bone marrow edema at posterior compartment of tibia. 
 - ACL; partial tear of the anterior cruciate ligament at posterior part 
 - Medial meniscus; combined vertical tear and radial tear at the  posterior horn  
 - Left knee effusion with synovitis

original_report: Das vordokumentierte Knochenmarksödem im lateralen Kompartiment regredient, ansonsten unauffällige Signalgebung der übrigen ossären Strukturen in den vorliegenden Sequenzen. Flächige Chondropathie im medialen Kompartiment ohne fokalen Knorpelschaden, die fokale T2-Signalanhebung in der Voruntersuchung möglicherweise Knorpelödem entsprechend. Retropatellar medial betonte oberflächliche Chondropathie. Dislozierter Lappenriss des Innenmeniskus aus der Pars intermedia und hinterer mit nach dorsal disloziertem Fragment, komplexe Rissbildung in der Restsubstanz. Kleiner Substanzdefekt im Außenmeniskusvorderhorn, der vordokumentierte DD winzige Lappenriss nicht mehr sicher abgrenzbar.  V. a. basisnahen inkompletten longitudinalen Riss im Pars intermedia und Hinterhorn des Außenmeniskus (5/20 sowie 3/102) mit deutlich Einblutungen in Lokalisation der popliteomeniskalen Faszikel (6/22) DD bei Ruptur. VKB-Ruptur femoralseitig. Hinteres Kreuzband mit intakter Signalgebung. Zunehmend narbige Veränderung bei Z. n. Partialläsion des MCL in den tiefen Anteilen, LCL mit intakter Signalgebung. Konstanter mäßiger Gelenkerguss. Flüssigkeitsgefüllte Baker-Zyste mit einer CC-Ausdehnung von 4,6 cm. Unauffällige Signalgebung der Quadrizeps- sowie Patellarsehne. Die miterfassten Weichteilanteile den vorliegenden Sequenzen mit unauffälliger Signalgebung.

issues.reason: The report describes 'Interstitial hyperintensity in the ACL, in favor of grade 1 injury' and the impression states 'R/O grade 1 ACL injury'. Grade 1 ACL injury represents intrasubstance signal abnormality without fiber disruption, which is not a tear. Under the RagSet convention, ACL=1 requires a tear/rupture; grade 1 sprain/intrasubstance signal maps to ACL=0.

issues.reason: The report describes 'Linear signal intensity in posterior horn of medial meniscus... in favor of grade 2 intrasubstance signal... maybe due to degeneration' and the impression states 'R/O degeneration of posterior horn of medial meniscus'. Per GOLD_ANALYSIS convention (26 positive / 32 negative), grade 2 intrasubstance signal/degeneration in the posterior horn of the medial meniscus maps to Medial_Meniscus=1.

issues.label: Medial_OA
issues.reason: The report explicitly states 'Wearing cartilage in the knee joint and spur formation in the posterior tibial plateau and fluid accumulation, Osteoarthritis noted'. The posterior tibial plateau is the medial compartment; this explicit compartment-specific cartilage wear and spur formation supports Medial_OA=1.

The lateral facet prominence refers to the patellofemoral joint (PF_OA), not the lateral tibiofemoral compartment. No explicit lateral tibiofemoral compartment cartilage wear or spur formation is described; therefore Lateral_OA=0.

In the medial compartment, there is buckethandle tear of the medial meniscus, at the anterior horn, body and posterior horn. There is displaced meniscal fragment into the intercondylar notch. There is focal low grade chondrosis (less than 50% thickness cartilage loss) at the posterolateral tibial plateau (about 1.9* 1.6 cm).  
 The lateral compartment, the meniscus is not torn and there is no focal chondrosis or chondral injury. 
 The patellofemoral joint, the patellar and trochlear cartilage appears congruent without chondral lesion. The medial patellofemoral ligament is intact.  
 In the intercondylar notch, the anterior cruciate ligament, at mid substance. The posterior cruciate ligament is intact. There is no anterior tibial translation. 
 The medial collateral ligamentous complexes are intact. The posteromedial oblique ligament is intact.  
 The lateral collateral ligament complexes are intact. The popliteofibular ligament is intact. The meniscopopliteal fascicles are intact.  
 The extensor mechanism is normal.  
 No knee effusion is present. The surrounding musculature is normal. There is no fracture or bone contusion.  Focal low grade chondrosis at the posterolateral tibial plateau (about 1.9* 1.6 cm) of right knee. 
  Buckethandle tear of the medial meniscus, at the anterior horn, body and posterior horn.

МР данни за увреда в задния рог на медиалния менискус – 2а степен. Тя се представя като хиперинтензна лезия с хоризонтален ход, недостигаща до артикулиращия хрущял. Във връзка с менискуса се изобразява малка менискусова киста с р-р 2,2 мм. Латерално от нея зад колатералния лигамент се изобразява мултилокуларна ганглион киста с р-р 48/15мм. Латералния менискус е нормално представен. Кръстни връзки – б.о. Колатералните лигаменти са със запазена цялост. Поплитеална ямка – б.о. Патела, хрущял на пателата – б.о. Лигамент на пателата и сухожилие на м. квадрицепс феморис – без особености. Ретинакулуми – без особености. Заключение: МР данни за увреда в задния рог на медиалния менискус – 2а степен. Малка менискусова киста и ганглион киста от медиалната страна на коляното.

MRI of the right knee was performed on a 1.5 Tesla system with a dedicated knee coil in three planes (axial, sagittal, and coronal), using a standard non-contrast protocol.

FINDINGS:
OSSEOUS STRUCTURES:
Alignment is anatomic. No acute fracture or bone bruise. Background marrow signal is normal without infiltrative marrow process. No aggressive osseous lesions.

JOINT SPACE:
No joint effusion. No intra-articular bodies. No Baker's cyst.

Medial meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.

Lateral meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.

Patellofemoral compartment cartilage: No focal cartilage defects.

Anterior cruciate ligament (ACL): Normal with both bundles intact.

COLLATERAL LIGAMENTS & POSTEROLATERAL CORNER:
Medial collateral ligament (MCL): Normal.

EXTENSOR MECHANISM:
Distal quadriceps tendon: Minimal distal quadriceps insertional tendinosis. No tendon tear.

No acute muscle strain or muscle atrophy. Visualized tendons not previously discussed are intact without tendinosis or tear.

SOFT TISSUES:
No soft tissue mass. Normal popliteal neurovascular bundle.

IMPRESSION:
Minimal distal quadriceps insertional tendinosis. Otherwise, no intra-articular injury.

IMAGING FINDINGS:

Nondiagnostic scout localizing images reviewed.

The medial meniscus is intact with the lateral meniscus is intact. 

Intact anterior cruciate ligament and posterior cruciate ligament.

The medial collateral ligament and posterior oblique ligament are intact. Moderate fluid accumulation within the pes anserine bursa.

The fibular collateral ligament and popliteus tendon attachments are intact. Biceps femoris tendon insertion is intact. Iliotibial band is intact.

The patellar retinacula are intact. No femoral trochlear dysplasia. The TT-TG distance measures 8 mm, within normal limits. The quadriceps and patellar tendons are intact. Focal full thickness cartilage denuding medial patellar facet near the patellar apex. Mild chondrosis throughout the remainder of the patellofemoral compartment. Preserved medial femorotibial articular cartilage. Tiny focus of full-thickness cartilage denuding central weightbearing aspect lateral tibial plateau.

Trace joint fluid. Regional musculature is within normal limits. No suspicious focal marrow signal alteration.

IMPRESSION:
1. No evidence of meniscal tear.
2. Moderate pes anserine bursitis.
3. Mild to moderate patellofemoral chondrosis and a tiny focus of high-grade chondrosis lateral tibial plateau. Findings may reflect evolving mild patellofemoral predominant osteoarthritis of the left knee.

TECHNIQUE:
MRI of the right knee was performed on a 1.5 Tesla system with a dedicated knee coil in three planes (axial, sagittal, and coronal), using a standard non-contrast protocol.

FINDINGS:
OSSEOUS STRUCTURES:
Alignment is anatomic. No acute fracture or bone bruise. Background marrow signal is normal without infiltrative marrow process. No aggressive osseous lesions.

JOINT SPACE:
Small joint effusion. No intra-articular bodies. No Baker's cyst.

MEDIAL COMPARTMENT:
Medial meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.
Medial compartment cartilage: No focal cartilage defects.

LATERAL COMPARTMENT:
Lateral meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.
Lateral compartment cartilage: High-grade cartilage loss at the weightbearing surface of the lateral femoral condyle with focal full-thickness defect measuring 5 x 4 mm with associated subchondral cystic change and marrow edema. Focal full-thickness fissure at the posterior nonweightbearing aspect of the lateral femoral condyle with subchondral cystic change. High grade fissuring along the lateral tibial plateau.

PATELLOFEMORAL COMPARTMENT:
Patellofemoral compartment cartilage: No focal cartilage defects.

CRUCIATE LIGAMENTS:
Anterior cruciate ligament (ACL): Normal with both bundles intact.
Posterior cruciate ligament (PCL): Normal.

COLLATERAL LIGAMENTS & POSTEROLATERAL CORNER:
Medial collateral ligament (MCL): Normal.
Lateral collateral ligament (LCL) complex: Normal.
Posterolateral corner structures: Normal.

EXTENSOR MECHANISM:
Distal quadriceps tendon: Mild distal quadriceps insertional tendinosis. No tendon tear. There is associated edema at the quadriceps fat pad.
Patella tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Medial patellofemoral ligament (MPFL) and patellar retinacula: Normal.
Patellofemoral tracking: No edema in superolateral Hoffa's fat pad. No lateral patellar tilt or translation. No patella alta. Normal patellar and trochlear morphology. Normal tibial tubercle-trochlear groove (TT-TG) distance measuring 12 mm.

MUSCLES/TENDONS:
No acute muscle strain or muscle atrophy. Visualized tendons not previously discussed are intact without tendinosis or tear.

SOFT TISSUES:
No soft tissue mass. Normal popliteal neurovascular bundle.

IMPRESSION:
1.	Lateral compartment chondrosis. 
2.	Mild distal quadriceps insertional tendinosis with associated edema at the quadriceps fat pad.
3.	Small joint effusion.

MRI of right knee without contrast. 
Pulse sequences: sagittal T1, axial, coronal, sagittal T2 FS, sagittal PD FS

Equivocal tear over posterior horn of lateral meniscus. 
3. R/O Mild medial & lateral collateral ligament sprain.
The quadriceps & patellar tendons show intact appearance. 
4. Mild to moderate knee joint effusion with synovial hypertrophy. R/O Synovitis. 
5. Bone marrow edema in medial & lateral femoral condyle, lateral tibial plateau, likely bone contusion.
Soft tissue edema in popliteal fossa. 
6. Intact patellar cartilage.

R/O Complete ACL tear. 
Tear of posterior horn of medial meniscus. Equivocal tear over posterior horn of lateral meniscus. 
R/O Mild medial & lateral collateral ligament sprain.
Mild to moderate knee joint effusion with synovitis. 
Bone contusion in medial & lateral femoral condyle, lateral tibial plateau.

Suggest clinical correlation.

Medial kollateral ligaman çevresinde sıvı artışı izlendi.Distal kuadriseps ve patellar tendonlar normaldir. Patella normal yerleşimlidir. Retinaküler devamsızlık yoktur. Patellar kıkırdak medial fasette yer yer fissür hatları izlendi(tip II kondromalazi).Suprapatellar bursada ve diz ekleminde hafif  sıvı artışı izlenmiştir. Diz eklemini oluşturan kemik yapılarda osteofitik değişiklikler özellikle medialde tibiofemoral  eklem mesafesinde daralma , tibiofemoral kartilajlarda bütünlük kaybı  subkondral skleroz bulguları izlenmiştir ( dejeneratif artrit bulguları ). Ayrıca tibial medial plato düzeyinde subkondral kist ve kemik iliği ödemi izlendi.Tibiofemoral eklem içerisinde  8 mm çapta  cisim izlendi(loose body). Komşuluğunda 15x10 mm boyutlarında septalı iç yapıda kistik lezyon izlendi(ganglion kisti).

original_report: SOL DİZ MRG. Tetkik protokolü: Çok düzlemli, çok sekanslı. Bulgular: Medial menisküs posterior horn ve gövde kesimde grade III dejenerasyon, serbest kenarda horizontal yırtık izlendi. Lateral menisküs anterior, posterior horn ve gövde kesimde grade II dejenerasyon izlendi. Anterior çapraz bağda miksoid dejenerasyona sekonder sinyal değişikliği izlendi. Medial kollateral ligamende  periligamentöz ödem izlendi. Ön çapraz bağ ve arka çapraz bağ, lateral kollateral ligaman normaldir.Distal kuadriseps ve patellar tendonlar normaldir. original_report: МР находка: МР данни за лезия на задния рог на медиалния менискус – grade 3. В него се изобразява хиперинтензна линия с хоризонтален ход, която достига до края на менискуса и до ставния хрущял. До него се изобразява киста с големина 4/3мм. Нормално изобразяване на предния рог на медиалния менискус, както и на предния и задния рог на латералния менискус. Костите, формиращи колянната става са с нормална форма. Вижда се дискретен костномозъчен едем в областта на медиалния кондил на тибията. Не се намират изменения в хрущяла на фемура, тибията  пателата. Кръстни връзки – интактни. Колатерални лигаменти, ретинакулуми на пателата – нормално изобразяване. Сухожилие на мускулус квадрицепс феморис, лигамент на пателата – без особености. Поплитеална ямка - б.о. Наличие на фабела. Няма данни за ставен излив. Изобразява се леко изразен едем в подкожието на предната повърхност на подбедрицата и колянната става. Заключение: МР данни за лезия и киста на задния рог на медиалния менискус – grade 3.

Il y a une extrusion modérée secondaire du corps méniscal. Par ailleurs, il y a des changements dégénératifs mucoïdes au sein de la corne postérieure et du corps du ménisque interne.

Il y a un œdème au pourtour du ligament collatéral interne suggérant une entorse de grade 1. Il y a également une légère composante de bursite du ligament collatéral interne située entre les fibres profondes méniscofémorales et les fibres superficielles. Il y a une légère composante de bursite de la patte d’oie avec une légère infiltration liquidienne à ce niveau. 

Il y a une atténuation modérée des surfaces cartilagineuses au compartiment fémorotibial interne, sans atteinte transfixiante. Il y a de petits ostéophytes marginaux. 

Le ménisque externe de même que le complexe ligamentaire collatéral externe sont intacts et sans déchirure. Il y a une légère atténuation diffuse des surfaces cartilagineuses au compartiment fémorotibial externe, sans atteinte transfixiante ni changement sous-chondral réactionnel associé. 

Il y a une légère atténuation du ligament croisé antérieur suggérant une ancienne déchirure partielle. Il n'y a pas de composante transfixiante. Le ligament croisé postérieur est intact et sans déchirure.

L’alignement patellofémoral est préservé. Il y a une atténuation modérée des surfaces cartilagineuses au compartiment patellofémoral avec une fissure chondrale de haut grade à la jonction de l’apex patellaire et de la facette patellaire externe. Il n'y a pas de changement sous-chondral réactionnel associé. Les tendons du quadriceps distal et patellaire sont intacts et sans déchirure.

Il y a des changements dégénératifs/chondropathie tricompartimentale légers à modérés tels que détaillés ci-haut.

Pas d'évidence de déchirure méniscale.

Findings:  Small joint effusion with mild synovitis. No intra-articular loose bodies. No sinister bone marrow changes.  Intact cruciate and collateral ligaments. Mild mucoid degeneration of the ACL. 14 mm x 13 mm x 13 mm intraosseous ganglion cyst at the level of the tibial attachment of the PCL.  Intact medial meniscus. Severe mucoid degeneration of the anterior horn of the lateral meniscus appears markedly attenuated. Fraying of the posterior horn of the lateral meniscus also demonstrated.  Normal appearance of the pes anserine tendons, distal biceps femoris tendon and distal iliotibial band. Minor ganglion cyst formation around the popliteus tendon. Tiny Baker's cyst.  Intact extensor mechanism. No evidence of fat pad impingement.  Mild insertional tendinosis of the medial head of gastrocnemius.  Minor low-grade chondral fibrillation noted along the posterior aspect of the medial femoral condyle. Otherwise well-maintained tricompartmental hyaline articular cartilage.  
Conclusion:  Small Baker's cyst. Severe mucoid degeneration of the anterior horn of the lateral meniscus appears markedly attenuated. Fraying of the posterior horn of the lateral meniscus also demonstrated. Mild mucoid degeneration of the ACL. Mild insertional tendinosis of the medial head of gastrocnemius.

original_report: МР находка: МР данни за изразени дегенеративни промени в дясната колянна става. Почти изцяло е лизиран ставният хрущял от медиалната страна, като ставната междина тук е стеснена.  От латералната страна ставната междина не е стеснена, но се изобразяват дефекти в ставния хрущял. Виждат се множество остеофити по кондилите на фемура и тибията. Изострени са интеркондиларните еминенции. Медиалният менискус е дегенеративно променен предимно в неговата средна трета и задна част, където менискусът е с уголемен напречник, повишен интензитет на сигнала и изместен встрани (експулсиран) от ставната междина. В близост до менискуса и под него се намира голяма мултилокуларна киста с размер 36/10мм. Кистата се разполага между ставната капсула и костта. Наличие на едем на тибията по съседство с кистата, най-вероятно от притискане. Латералният менискус е с нормална форма и сигнален интензитет. МР данни за хондромалация на пателата – 4 степен. Пателарният хрущял е изтънен и с неравни контурни очертания. Визуализира се субхондрален костномозъчен едем в пателата. МР данни за малък ставен излив. Вижда се малка киста в тибията под инсерцията на предната кръстна връзка. Кръстните връзки са интактни. Колатерални лигаменти – нормално изобразяване. Лигамент на пателата, сухожилие на м. квадрицепс феморис – без особености. Поплитеална ямка – б.о. Едем на меките тъкани около коляното. Заключение:  МР данни за гонартроза. Дегенерирал медиален менискус, като част от менискуса е експулсиран. Мултилокуларна киста на медиалния менискус. Малък ставен излив. Хондромалация на пателата – 4 степен.

Exam Type: MRI KNEE RIGHT WO CONTRAST
Exam Date and Time: [DATE] [TIME]
Indication: 4 months of right lateral knee pain
Comparison: No relevant prior studies available for comparison.

TECHNIQUE:
MRI of the right knee was performed on a 1.5 Tesla system with a dedicated knee coil in three planes (axial, sagittal, and coronal), using a standard non-contrast protocol.

FINDINGS:
OSSEOUS STRUCTURES:
Alignment is anatomic. No acute fracture or bone bruise. Background marrow signal is normal without infiltrative marrow process. No aggressive osseous lesions.

JOINT SPACE:
Trace joint effusion. No intra-articular bodies. No Baker's cyst.

MEDIAL COMPARTMENT:
Medial meniscus: Partial tear of the posterior horn/root attachment with multiloculated parameniscal cyst formation at the posterior joint recess measuring 21 x 17 x 8 mm.
Medial compartment cartilage: No focal cartilage defects.

LATERAL COMPARTMENT:
Lateral meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.
Lateral compartment cartilage: No focal cartilage defects.

PATELLOFEMORAL COMPARTMENT:
Patellofemoral compartment cartilage: No focal cartilage defects.

CRUCIATE LIGAMENTS:
Anterior cruciate ligament (ACL): Attenuation of the ACL, favored to represent a prior partial tear, with intrasubstance ganglion cyst formation of the proximal attachment.
Posterior cruciate ligament (PCL): Normal.

COLLATERAL LIGAMENTS & POSTEROLATERAL CORNER:
Medial collateral ligament (MCL): Normal.
Lateral collateral ligament (LCL) complex: Normal.
Posterolateral corner structures: Normal.

EXTENSOR MECHANISM:
Distal quadriceps tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Patella tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Medial patellofemoral ligament (MPFL) and patellar retinacula: Normal.
Patellofemoral tracking: No edema in superolateral Hoffa's fat pad. No lateral patellar tilt or translation. No patella alta. Normal patellar and trochlear morphology. Normal tibial tubercle-trochlear groove (TT-TG) distance measuring 11 mm.

MUSCLES/TENDONS:
No acute muscle strain or muscle atrophy. Visualized tendons not previously discussed are intact without tendinosis or tear.

SOFT TISSUES:
No soft tissue mass. Normal popliteal neurovascular bundle.

IMPRESSION:
1.	Partial tear of the posterior root attachment of the medial meniscus with associated parameniscal cyst in the posterior joint recess measuring up to 2.1 cm.
2.	Attenuation of the anterior cruciate ligament (ACL), favored to represent a prior partial tear.

MRI RIGHT KNEE:

INDICATION:    [Age] active male unable to exercise due to right knee pain on exertion. Lateral right knee pain.

PRIOR IMAGING: None.    
.
TECHNICAL INFORMATION AND PROTOCOL:

Proton density and T2 weighted sagittal, coronal and axial imaging was performed through the knee including a 3D Fat suppressed proton density weighted sequence. No contrast was administered.

FINDINGS:

The 3-D proton density sequence was reformatted and manipulated to aid in the interpretation of this examination.

The extensor mechanism is intact and appears unremarkable. There is mild edema in the suprapatellar fat pad. This finding is mild, equivocal and is nonspecific but may correlate clinically with dynamic and symptomatic impingement of the fat pad.

The patellofemoral ligaments are intact and unremarkable. Articular cartilage of the patellofemoral joint is well-maintained.

The TT-TG distance measures about 9 mm, within normal limits.

The lateral meniscus is intact and appears unremarkable. Articular cartilage of lateral joint compartment is well-maintained.

The medial meniscus is intact and unremarkable. Articular cartilage of the medial joint compartment is well-maintained.

The anterior cruciate ligament, posterior cruciate ligament and medial collateral ligament are intact and appear unremarkable.

The lateral collateral ligament complex is intact. There is a trace of fluid deep to the IT band but no evidence of synovitis to suggest IT band syndrome.

Fibular collateral ligament, popliteus tendon and biceps femoris tendon are intact.

There is a trace Baker's cyst. No significant knee effusion.

There is a small parameniscal ganglion cyst demonstrated arising near the posterior root attachment of medial meniscus extending around the posterior cruciate ligament measuring about 1.3 x 1.0 x 0.4 cm. No associated meniscal tear is seen to account for this ganglion cyst.

INTERPRETATION: 

No evidence of internal derangement.

Small ganglion cyst in the popliteal fossa.

Mild edema in the suprapatellar fat pad, nonspecific.

No definite cause for lateral joint pain is identified.

Small joint effusion. No intra-articular bodies. Small Baker's cyst.

Lateral meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.

COLLATERAL LIGAMENTS & POSTEROLATERAL CORNER:

No acute muscle strain or muscle atrophy. Visualized tendons not previously discussed are intact without tendinosis or tear.

SOFT TISSUES:

IMPRESSION:

4. Small joint effusion. Small Baker's cyst.

Na nativnim MR presjecima kroz desno koljeno vide se umjerene degenerativne promjene
femorotibijalnog zgloba uz honodromalaciju 3. stupnja hrskavice lateralnog i 2. stupnja
medijalnog kondila femura. Izražene degenerativne promjene femoropatelarnog zgloba sa
zonama koštanog edema patele i trohleje femura te denudacijom hrskavice lateralne fasete
patele te hondromalacijom 4. stupnja hrskavice trohleje femura.
Manje zone koštanog edema u području lateralnog kondila femura.
Prednji križni ligament je održanog kontinuiteta, promijenjenih intenziteta signala, uz vidljive
sitne ganglion ciste na proksimalnom hvatištu - prvenstveno u sklopu umjerenih degenerativnih
promjena, ddg. ranija parcijalna ruptura.
Stražnji križni ligament je primjerenih intenziteta signala i održanog kontinuiteta.
Medijalni menisk je stanjen, promijenjenih intenziteta signala u području trupa te stražnjeg roga
i korijena, u smislu ranije kompleksne, predominantno horizontalne rupture na podlozi
degenerativnih promjena. Sam menisk je ekstrudiran uz posljedično blagu distenziju medijalnog
kolateralnog ligamenta koji je bez znakova rupture. Od trupa meniska prema kaudalno se prate
parameniscealne ciste ukupnih dimenzija 24 x 15 x 37 mm (APxLLxCC, utiskuju se prema
medijalnom kolateralnom ligamentu i straga prema tetivama pes anserinus.
Degenerativne promjene lateralnog meniska, bez znakova rupture. Prominentan Wrisbergov
ligament.
Lateralni kolateralni ligament je održanog kontinuiteta, entezopatski promijenjenog proksimalnog
hvatišta.
Tendinopatija tetive popliteusa. Primjeren prikaz iliotibijalnog trakta i pes anserinus.
Tendinopatske promjene tetive kvadricepsa.
Patelarni ligament je primjerenih intenziteta signala, održanog kontinuiteta.
Patelarni retinakulumi održani.
Umjerena količina izljeva u zglobu, najizraženije u lateralnom recesusu uz hipertrofiju sinovije
suprapatelarno i posteriorno uz kondile femura.
Ne nalazi se znakova poplitealne ciste.

Medyal menisküs arka boynuzundaki dejenerasyona arka boynuzu-kökü bileşkesi düzeyindeki tam kat vertikal yırtık eşlik ediyor. Medyal menisküs medyale 6 mm ekstrüde ve iç yan bağı hafifçe basılıyor. Lateral menisküs normal. Çapraz ve yan bağlar bunların dışında normal. Distal femur ve proksimal tibya diyafizometafizyal kesimlerindeki artmış hematopoetik kemik iliği aktivitesi ile uyumlu intensite değişiklikleri anemi ile birliktelik gösterebilir. Ekstensör mekanizma korunmuş. Proksimal tibyofibular eklem normal. Yüzeyel pre/infrapatellar cilt altı bağ dokusu ödemli. Pes anserinus tendonların derininde hafif dereceli yumuşak doku inflamasyonu mevcut.

Exam Type: MRI KNEE LEFT WO CONTRAST
Exam Date and Time: [DATE] [TIME]
Indication: Pain for 3 days. Ski accident.
Comparison: No relevant prior studies available for comparison.

TECHNIQUE:
MRI of the left knee was performed on a 1.5 Tesla system with a dedicated knee coil in three planes (axial, sagittal, and coronal), using a standard non-contrast protocol.

FINDINGS:
OSSEOUS STRUCTURES:
Alignment is anatomic. Osseous contusion along the peripheral aspect of the lateral femoral condyle and along the medial aspect of the patella consistent with a recent transient patellar dislocation. Background marrow signal is normal without infiltrative marrow process. No aggressive osseous lesions.

JOINT SPACE:
Large joint hemarthrosis with intra-articular clot in the suprapatellar joint recess.  No Baker's cyst.

MEDIAL COMPARTMENT:
Medial meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.
Medial compartment cartilage: No focal cartilage defects.

LATERAL COMPARTMENT:
Lateral meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.
Lateral compartment cartilage: No focal cartilage defects.

PATELLOFEMORAL COMPARTMENT:
Patellofemoral compartment cartilage: No focal cartilage defects.

CRUCIATE LIGAMENTS:
Anterior cruciate ligament (ACL): Normal with both bundles intact.
Posterior cruciate ligament (PCL): Normal.

COLLATERAL LIGAMENTS & POSTEROLATERAL CORNER:
Medial collateral ligament (MCL): Normal.
Lateral collateral ligament (LCL) complex: Normal.
Posterolateral corner structures: Normal.

EXTENSOR MECHANISM:
Distal quadriceps tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Patella tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Medial patellofemoral ligament (MPFL) and patellar retinacula: Complete tear of the MPFL from the adductor tubercle. High-grade sprain of the medial patellar retinaculum at the patellar attachment.
Patellofemoral tracking: Lateral patellar tilt and translation. Borderline patella alta. Oblique morphology of the trochlea. Increased tibial tubercle-trochlear groove (TT-TG) distance measuring 25 mm.

MUSCLES/TENDONS:
No acute muscle strain or muscle atrophy. Visualized tendons not previously discussed are intact without tendinosis or tear.

SOFT TISSUES:
No soft tissue mass. Normal popliteal neurovascular bundle.

IMPRESSION:
1.	Findings of a recent transient lateral patellar dislocation with osseous contusions, large knee joint hemarthrosis, and injuries of the medial patellofemoral ligament and patellar retinacula, as described above.
2.	Anatomic morphology predisposing to patellofemoral maltracking, as described above.

Mediales Kompartiment:
Regelrechtes Knochenmarksignal. Oberflächliche Knorpelirregularitäten der medialen Femurcondyle. Kein fokal tiefgreifender oder vollschichtiger Knorpeldefekt. Kein subchondrales Knochenödem. Nach ventral und in die Notch umgeschlagener Korbhenkelriss des Innenmeniskus aus der Pars intermedia und Hinterhorn. Gering Flüssigkeit um das MCL, bei aber erhaltener Bandstruktur. Abgerundetes Ossikel im medialen Kopf des M. gastrocnemius (Serie 4/ Image 8) mit geringer tendinopathischer Veränderung des Muskels.

Laterales Kompartiment:
Regelrechtes Knochenmarksignal. Intakter Knorpel. 

Femoropatellares Gleitlager und Trochlea:
Regelrechtes Knochenmarksignal. Intakter Knorpel. Regelrechte Darstellung der Quadrizeps- und Patellarsehne. Regelrechte Darstellung des Hoffa`schen Fettkörpers.

Kreuzbänder:
Intakte Kreuzbänder. 

Muskulatur und übrige Weichteile:
Ausgdehnter Hämarthros mit verdickter Synovia und synovialen Proliferationen. Plica mediopatellaris Typ B nach Sakakibara. Flüssigkeitsgefüllte Baker-Zyste.

MRI RIGHT KNEE

Clinical information: 4 month history of right lateral knee pain post injury. Please rule out lateral meniscal tear.

Technique: Multiplanar MR of the knee was performed.

Comparison: None available

Findings: 

The proximal anterior cruciate ligament appears thickened with increased signal intensity, in keeping with a low-grade partial-thickness injury, nonacute. No anterior drawer sign. The posterior cruciate ligament is intact.

The medial collateral and lateral collateral ligaments are intact. Posterolateral corner structures are intact.

The bilateral menisci are intact.

The distal quadriceps and patellar tendons are intact. The patella is normally positioned within the femoral groove. There is no retinacular disruption.

No fracture or osseous lesion is seen. No bone marrow edema.

Cartilage thickness and signal intensity is preserved.

No joint effusion or loose body. No Baker's cyst. No abnormal muscle edema. 

IMPRESSION
1. No evidence of meniscal injury.
2. Non-acute low-grade partial thickness injury of the proximal anterior cruciate ligament.

original_report:
Trouvailles :

Il n’y a pas d’épanchement intra-articulaire significatif ou de kyste poplité.

Il y a changements dégénératifs légers à modérés au niveau patellofémoral. Il y a amincissement du cartilage avec fibrillation superficielle plus proéminent impliquant la facette latérale de la rotule avec fissure partielle de la facette médiale. Il y a aussi un léger amincissement du cartilage à la partie latérale de la trochlée du fémur. La rotule démontre une légère subluxation latérale. Il y a aussi œdème au niveau de la partie supéro-latérale du pad graisseux infra-rotulien entre le tendon rotulien et le condyle fémoral externe.

Le cartilage du compartiment interne et externe est préservé. Les ménisques sont sans particularité. Autrement le ligament croisé antérieur, le ligament croisé postérieur, le mécanisme des extenseurs, le ligament collatéral interne, le semi-membraneux, le muscle et tendon du poplité, le biceps fémoris distal, le ligament collatéral externe et la bandelette ilio-tibiale sont sans particularité.

Conclusion :

Œdème au niveau du pad graisseux suggestif d’un syndrome de friction (patellar tendon lateral femoral condyle friction syndrome). Il y a aussi changements dégénératifs au niveau patellofémoral. La combinaison des trouvailles est suggestif d’une biomécanique anormale au niveau patellofémoral.

issues.reason: The report describes a 'diepe mediale capsulaire ligament sprain' (deep medial capsular ligament sprain), which is distinct from the MCL (medial collateral ligament). The MCL is an extracapsular structure, while the deep medial capsular ligament is part of the joint capsule. The report does not mention MCL injury, and the GOLD_ANALYSIS shows MCL positive in only 9 of 58 cases, indicating a strict definition. Therefore, MCL should be 0.

Zur Voruntersuchung vom konstant oberflächliche Knorpelirrgeularität an der inferiomedialen Patellafacette (Serie 7/ Image 13). Kein tiefgreifender oder vollschichtiger Knorpeldefekt. Sulcus-Winkel von 148° im Sinne einer Trochleadysplasie Typ A nach Dejour. Patellaform  Typ III nach Wiberg.

Kreuzbänder:
Intakte Kreuzbänder.

Geringer Gelenkerguss mit verdickter Synovia. Bekanntes zur konventionellen Röntgenaufnahme vom [DATE] und [DATE] jeweils  lagedifferentes 5 x 11 x cc 12 mm messendes freies osteochondrales Fragment angrenzend an die laterale Femurcondyle (Serie 4/ Image 15).

MRI of right Knee with 
-Locator, SG PD FatSat, SG T2W FS, SG T1W, CO T2W FS, AX T2W FS

* Obliteration of lateral meniscus, reflecting tear. 
* Osteophytes and irregular thining of intra-articular cartilage, more severe at lateral femorotibial joint with subchondral sclerosis and mild edema and tiny cystic change, reflecting osteoarthritis
  Grade 3 chondromalacia of patella and femoral trochlea
* Joint effusion and suprapatellar bursitis with suprapatellar, lateral and medial plicae; hypertrophy of the synovium, indicative of synovitis.
> A lobulated cystic lesion in medial popliteal fossa between the tendons of the medial head of the gastrocnemius and the semimembranosus muscles, in favor of Baker's cyst.
  Mild fat stranding over popliteal fossa.
> The contour of ACL & PCL appear to be within normal, no abnormal signal intensity is noted.
> Both medial & lateral collateral ligaments appear to be within normal.
> Mild subcutaneous edema over right knee.

Impression: 
1.Osteoarthritis of right knee, more severe at lateral femorotibial joint.
2.Tear of lateral meniscus.
3.Moderate joint effusion-synovitis of right knee and large Baker's cyst.
4.Mild subcutanoeus edema over right knee.
Suggest correlation with clinical manifestation

Exam Type: MRI KNEE RIGHT WO CONTRAST
Exam Date and Time: [DATE] [TIME]
Indication: Chronic right knee pain worse with activity. Intermittently gives out, localized anteriorly.
Comparison: No relevant prior studies available for comparison.

TECHNIQUE:
MRI of the right knee was performed on a 1.5 Tesla system with a dedicated knee coil in three planes (axial, sagittal, and coronal), using a standard non-contrast protocol.

FINDINGS:
OSSEOUS STRUCTURES:
Alignment is anatomic. No acute fracture or bone bruise. Background marrow signal is normal without infiltrative marrow process. No aggressive osseous lesions.

JOINT SPACE:
Small joint effusion. No intra-articular bodies. No Baker's cyst.

MEDIAL COMPARTMENT:
Medial meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.
Medial compartment cartilage: No focal cartilage defects.

LATERAL COMPARTMENT:
Lateral meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.
Lateral compartment cartilage: High-grade partial-thickness cartilage loss about the anterior weightbearing aspect lateral femoral condyle more centrally towards the intercondylar notch. Low-grade partial-thickness cartilage loss along the central and posterior lateral tibial plateau.

PATELLOFEMORAL COMPARTMENT:
Patellofemoral compartment cartilage: High-grade partial-thickness fissuring at the median ridge.

CRUCIATE LIGAMENTS:
Anterior cruciate ligament (ACL): Normal with both bundles intact.
Posterior cruciate ligament (PCL): Normal.

COLLATERAL LIGAMENTS & POSTEROLATERAL CORNER:
Medial collateral ligament (MCL): Normal.
Lateral collateral ligament (LCL) complex: Normal.
Posterolateral corner structures: Normal.

EXTENSOR MECHANISM:
Distal quadriceps tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Patella tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Medial patellofemoral ligament (MPFL) and patellar retinacula: Normal.
Patellofemoral tracking: No edema in superolateral Hoffa's fat pad. No lateral patellar tilt or translation. No patella alta. Normal patellar and trochlear morphology. Normal tibial tubercle-trochlear groove (TT-TG) distance measuring 14 mm.

MUSCLES/TENDONS:
No acute muscle strain or muscle atrophy. Visualized tendons not previously discussed are intact without tendinosis or tear.

SOFT TISSUES:
No soft tissue mass. Normal popliteal neurovascular bundle.

IMPRESSION:
Lateral tibiofemoral and patellofemoral compartment chondrosis as described.

MRI of the left knee was performed on a 1.0 system with a dedicated knee coil in three planes (axial, sagittal, and coronal), using a standard non-contrast protocol.

Alignment is anatomic. No acute fracture or bone bruise. Background marrow signal is normal without infiltrative marrow process. No aggressive osseous lesions.

No joint effusion. No intra-articular bodies. 3 small Baker's cyst.

Medial meniscus: Mild intrasubstance heterogeneous signal intensity at the junction of the body and posterior horn. No definite meniscal tear.

Lateral meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.

Anterior cruciate ligament (ACL): Normal with both bundles intact.

COLLATERAL LIGAMENTS & POSTEROLATERAL CORNER:
Medial collateral ligament (MCL): Normal.

Distal quadriceps tendon: No tendinosis or tear.

MUSCLES/TENDONS:
No acute muscle strain or muscle atrophy. Visualized tendons not previously discussed are intact without tendinosis or tear.

SOFT TISSUES:
No soft tissue mass. Normal popliteal neurovascular bundle.

IMPRESSION:

original_report:
Antecedentes Clínicos:
Torsión de rodilla izquierda. Descartar menisco discoideo. No se cuenta con estudios previos.
Hallazgos:
Adelgazamiento difuso del LCA con aumento de señal, correlacionar con antecedentes regionales.
LCP y ligamentos colaterales dentro de límites normales.
Discreto aumento de señal sugiriendo edema óseo periférico del cóndilo femoral medial. No hay
otras alteraciones de señal de la médula ósea.
Amputación del cuerno anterior y cuerpo del menisco lateral con leve extrusión meniscal.
Leve aumento de señal del meniscocapsular del cuerno posterior del menisco medial. El resto del
menisco medial sin alteraciones significativas.
Cartílagos de los compartimentos femorotibiales y patelofemorales sin alteraciones.
Leve aumento de señal del aspecto superoexterno de la grasa de Hoffa.
No hay significativo derrame articular ni quistes poplíteos.
Aumento de señal del tercio proximal del tendón rotuliano con pequeña rotura lineal de las fibras
centrales. Tendón cuadricipital, tendones de la pata de ganso, bíceps femoral y banda iliotibial
dentro de límites normales.
Impresión:
Adelgazamiento difuso con aumento de señal del LCA, correlacionar con antecedentes regionales
y estabilidad clínica.
Discreto edema óseo periférico, probablemente regresión del cóndilo femoral medial.
Amputación del cuerno anterior y cuerpo del menisco lateral con leve extrusión meniscal.
Mínimo aumento de señal de la unión meniscocapsular del cuerno posterior del menisco medial.
Signos de un síndrome de hiperpresión externa de la rótula.
Tendinosis rotuliana proximal con pequeña rotura lineal intrasustancia de sus fibras centrales.

Exam Type: MRI KNEE LEFT WO CONTRAST
Exam Date and Time: [DATE] [TIME]
Indication: Greater than one month history of knee pain, work-related. Reports history of prior arthroscopic surgery multiple years ago at Harborview Medical Center. 
Comparison: No relevant prior studies available for comparison.

TECHNIQUE:
MRI of the left knee was performed on a 1.5 Tesla system with a dedicated knee coil in three planes (axial, sagittal, and coronal), using a standard non-contrast protocol.

FINDINGS:
OSSEOUS STRUCTURES:
Patella alta. No acute fracture or bone bruise. Background marrow signal is normal without infiltrative marrow process. No aggressive osseous lesions.

JOINT SPACE:
No joint effusion. No intra-articular bodies. Small Baker's cyst.

MEDIAL COMPARTMENT:
Medial meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.
Medial compartment cartilage: No focal cartilage defects.

LATERAL COMPARTMENT:
Lateral meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.
Lateral compartment cartilage: No focal cartilage defects.

PATELLOFEMORAL COMPARTMENT:
Patellofemoral compartment cartilage: Low-grade fissuring medial patellar facet with mild subchondral marrow edema peripherally.

CRUCIATE LIGAMENTS:
Anterior cruciate ligament (ACL): Normal with both bundles intact.
Posterior cruciate ligament (PCL): Normal.

COLLATERAL LIGAMENTS & POSTEROLATERAL CORNER:
Medial collateral ligament (MCL): Normal.
Lateral collateral ligament (LCL) complex: Normal.
Posterolateral corner structures: Normal.

EXTENSOR MECHANISM:
Distal quadriceps tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Patella tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Medial patellofemoral ligament (MPFL) and patellar retinacula: Normal.
Patellofemoral tracking: No edema in superolateral Hoffa's fat pad. No lateral patellar tilt or translation. No patella alta. Asymmetry of the trochlear facets. Increased tibial tubercle-trochlear groove (TT-TG) distance measuring 23 mm.

MUSCLES/TENDONS:
No acute muscle strain or muscle atrophy. Visualized tendons not previously discussed are intact without tendinosis or tear.

SOFT TISSUES:
No soft tissue mass. Normal popliteal neurovascular bundle.

IMPRESSION:
Anatomic morphology which may predispose to lateral patellofemoral maltracking with minimal patellar chondrosis.
